jobs.description:
Description

Job Summary:

We are looking for a visionary and technically strong Director of Software Engineering to lead our engineering teams in building scalable, secure, and high-performance software solutions. This role is pivotal in shaping our technical strategy, driving engineering excellence, and delivering innovative products in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy
Define and execute the engineering roadmap in alignment with company goals and product strategy, and technical leadership.
Lead and mentor tech leads, software and QA engineers across multiple teams.
Foster a high-performance culture focused on innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Establish clear goals, metrics, and accountability frameworks for engineering teams

Technical Oversight
Help guide architectural decisions and ensure adherence to modern software engineering principles.
Champion best practices in software design, testing, deployment, and operations.
Evaluate and implement new technologies to improve scalability, reliability, and developer productivity.

Project & Product Delivery
Collaborate with leadership, design, and the Product Delivery Office to deliver high-quality software on time and within scope.
Strong command of SDLC best practices, agile methodologies, and application lifecycle management
Ensure robust monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices are in place.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in a leadership role.
Proven experience leading engineering teams in a technical product or SaaS company.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures (AWS and Azure), microservices, and distributed systems.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across departments.
Experience with Agile, Scrum, or SAFe methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with security and compliance standards (e.g., FedRAMP, PCI, etc.)
Background in AI/ML, data engineering, or platform engineering is a plus.

About the Organization Eccalon provides global solutions to the most challenging technological issues of the 21st-century, and our evolving portfolio spans five major markets: Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, Aerospace & Defense, Material Sciences, Advance Manufacturing, Sports Science, Biotechnology, and Health & Life Sciences.

Why Join Us?

Eccalon's Executives foster a supportive work environment allowing our teams to thrive, and have a fierce dedication to innovation, security, and people. Our culture is built on inclusion, teamwork, trust, and we are committed to offering career advancement opportunities to all employees. Encouraging a healthy and balanced life, we offer an extensive benefits package to support the wellness of our employees and their families. You will be joining a team of innovators, working with cutting edge technologies, supporting mission critical projects, and making an impact.

Apply today to advance your career!

jobs.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

Job Title: Director, Engineering Management (HW Engineering Discipline Lead)

Job Code: 45829

Job Location: Fort Wayne, IN

Job Schedule: 9/80 (Every other Friday off)

Job Description:

For more than 60 years, L3Harris Technologies has been at the forefront of space innovation, developing mission critical technologies for missile warning and weather detection that protect lives and property around the world every day. We are currently seeking a highly accomplished engineering leader to oversee a large, multi-disciplinary hardware organization within our growing Spectral Solutions division within the Space Systems Sector. This role leads 200+ engineers across mechanical and electrical disciplines supporting the development and delivery of advanced infrared payloads and space vehicle systems for the missile defense and global weather missions.

The ideal candidate brings strong technical credibility, proven organizational leadership, and the ability to operate both strategically and tactically. This leader will define and communicate a compelling vision, influence senior leaders, and build a high-performing engineering organization through effective hiring, mentoring, and talent development.

This role is central to shaping the future of space hardware development as the market continues to evolve from bespoke, exquisite systems toward more proliferated and production-oriented architectures. The successful candidate will bring the judgment to balance technical performance with cost, schedule, manufacturability, and mission assurance.

This position is located in Fort Wayne, Indiana, a Northeast Indiana engineering hub offering an average commute of under 20 minutes, a housing market consistently recognized as among the more affordable in the U.S., an extensive parks and trail system, and a growing downtown that features local restaurants, arts, and year-round community events.

Essential Functions:

Lead a large, geographically distributed hardware engineering organization spanning mechanical, thermal, structural, materials, analog, digital, power, reliability, and radiation disciplines
Provide leadership across the full product lifecycle, including capture, design, procurement, assembly, integration, test, qualification, delivery, and post-delivery support
Drive execution across a portfolio of space programs ranging from exquisite, high-reliability missions to faster-turn demonstration efforts
Develop and execute organizational strategy for technology, talent growth and succession, and continuous improvement
Partner with business, program, supply chain, and technical leaders
Communicate effectively with executives, customers, and technical teams to align vision, priorities, and execution
Ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI clearance
Willingness to travel 10% - 20%

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or related field with a minimum of 15 years of prior relevant experience; or Graduate Degree with a minimum of 13 years of prior related experience; or in lieu of a degree, 19 years of prior related experience

Preferred Additional Skills:

Experience with electro-optical or infrared payload systems
Experience leading large engineering teams across multiple hardware disciplines
Experience in space hardware or other high-reliability mission technology development
Experience with complex space-based designs including electro-optical payloads
Experience with design for manufacturability, low-rate initial production, and transitioning from development to production
Experience with ECAD, MCAD, and configuration management
Experience with cost estimating, resource planning, and Earned Value Management
Experience using leading indicators and metrics to drive product or organizational improvement
Demonstrated success scaling teams and building talent pipelines in support of growth
Experience applying lean principles, modern tools, and process improvements to engineering organizations
Experience working with supply chain and manufacturing to support supplier development, production readiness, and product acceptance
Experience developing new products for NASA, NOAA, USSF or other high-reliability customers

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Machine Learning Recommendations
jobs.description:
Company Description

Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

What's the role?

We are looking for a Director of Engineering, Machine Learning to lead Etsy's Recommendations, the team responsible for the algorithms and systems that power personalized onsite-discovery across our marketplace. This is a pivotal technical leadership role at the intersection of ML research, systems engineering, and product impact.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end technical strategy for how Etsy connects buyers with the right listings across the App Homefeed, Web Home, Shop Home, Listing pages, Cart, and Checkout pages. You will lead a team of ML engineers, applied scientists, and system engineers organized across three areas: candidate retrieval, ranking, and recommendation systems. You will drive the evolution of our models from state-of-the-art multi-interest retrieval and multi-task deep ranking to next-generation LLM-powered foresight recommendations and generative discovery experiences. The biggest unsolved challenge in front of this team is not just relevance — it is inspiration: helping buyers discover new ideas and start new shopping missions.

This opportunity is a full-time position reporting to the VP of Engineering at Search, Recommendations, and Ads.

What's this team like at Etsy?

The Recommendations organization sits at the heart of Etsy's marketplace. We own over 60 recommendation modules across Etsy's surfaces, with our most impactful work powering the App Homefeed, Web Home, Shop Home, Listing pages, Cart, and Checkout pages.

Our ML stack spans the full recommendation pipeline. On retrieval, we build and evolve our multi-interest user-to-listing embedding model as well as a LLM-powered system that generates forward-looking shopping ideas based on buyer personas. On ranking, we operate a multi-task deep ranking model jointly optimizing for clicks, favorites, ads-to-cart, and purchases. Underpinning all of this is ReactorRecs, our in-house serving and orchestration platform that composes retrieval, ranking, filtering, and experimentation across 200+ recommendation modules.

We believe in research grounded in real user impact. We run rigorous offline and online experiments, use LLM-based and human-in-the-loop evaluation, and hold ourselves to both engagement and discovery metrics.

What does the day-to-day look like?

Define and drive the multi-year product and technical roadmap for Recommendations ML, with particular focus on personalization, foresight, diversity, and content freshness — the four problems where we have the most room to grow.
Lead and grow a team of ML engineers, applied scientists, and platform engineers across retrieval, ranking, and systems sub-teams, each with its own engineering manager.
Partner closely with product, UX, and cross-functional ML teams (Search, Ads, Buyer Understanding, Content Understanding) to align on a coherent, end-to-end buyer experience and shared infrastructure investments.
Drive the architectural evolution from our current two-stage retrieval-and-ranking pipeline toward more generative and LLM-integrated recommendation architectures.
Set the technical bar for model development, experimentation, evaluation, and productionization — including our offline VQA and LLM-as-judge evaluation frameworks.
Champion a high-velocity experimentation culture: our Multi-Variant Dataset (MVD) framework allows parallel A/B tests across retrieval and ranking components, and you should know how to squeeze value out of every experiment.
Mentor and develop engineering talent at all levels, including Staff and Senior Staff engineers and the engineering managers who report to you.
Of course, this is just a sample of the kinds of work this role will require! You should assume that your role will encompass other tasks, too, and that your job duties and responsibilities may change from time to time at Etsy's discretion, or otherwise applicable with local law.

Qualities That Will Help You Thrive

Proven ability to lead and develop multi-disciplinary teams of ML engineers, applied scientists, and platform engineers, including managing managers and senior managers.
10+ years of progressive experience in ML engineering, with demonstrated success shipping large-scale recommendation, retrieval, or ranking systems into production.
A track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical programs to completion — including navigating shared infrastructure decisions with partner teams in Search, Ads, or adjacent ML platforms.
Sharp instincts for balancing near-term product impact with mid-to-long-term research investment, and the ability to communicate that trade-off clearly to both engineering and product leadership.
Familiarity with large-scale ML infrastructure: distributed training (TensorFlow, PyTorch), feature stores, model serving, and online experimentation frameworks.

Compensation & Benefits

In addition to salary, you'll be eligible for an equity package, an annual performance bonus, and our competitive benefits that support you and your family. Base salary is determined by your location, skills, and experience.

Etsy uses two geographic pay zones to reflect the labor markets where we compete for talent: one called Geo-1, covering the New York City metropolitan area, San Francisco Bay Area, and Seattle metropolitan area, and one called Geo-2, covering all other U.S. locations. Salary ranges for this role vary by zone and are listed below.

Location

We prioritize candidates based within commutable distance of Etsy’s Brooklyn Office. Depending on proximity, we ask team members to come in once or twice per week. Remote candidates outside commutable distance may be considered on a case-by-case basis, with the expectation of occasional travel to the office. Learn more details about our work modes and workplace safety policies here.

Salary Range

Geo-1: 296,000.00 - 400,000.00 USD Annual
Geo-2: 266,000.00 - 360,000.00 USD Annual

What's Next

If you're interested in joining the team at Etsy, please share your resume with us and feel free to include a cover letter if you'd like. As we hope you've seen already, Etsy is a place that values individuality and variety. We don't want you to be like everyone else -- we want you to be like you! So tell us what you're all about.

Our Promise

At Etsy, we believe that a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Etsy is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship or immigration status, marital or familial status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status**, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law**. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview or hiring process, please let your recruiter know and we will work with you to meet your needs. While Etsy supports visa sponsorship, sponsorship opportunities may be limited to certain roles and skills.

We believe how we work is just as important as what we work on, and we are guided by three key principles: We are one team who embraces the power of learning and collaboration; We innovate for impact; and Our innovation is multidimensional.

Sitting at the heart of BAE Systems Electronic Systems (ES), FAST Labs provides the next generation of technology across ES’s defense and commercial portfolios. We seek to turn groundbreaking research and partnerships into real-life impact for our customers, as we develop advanced capabilities in advanced electronics, EW, sensors and processing, AI, autonomy, RF, EO/IR, cyber, and more. We value internal and external partnerships and collaborate across a broad innovation ecosystem that includes DoW/IC labs and research teams, universities, small businesses, and venture firms/accelerators – all in service of developing advanced technologies to enable our nation’s warfighting mission needs.

We are seeking a Technology Development Director (TDD) to lead our Networked EM eXploitation for Unified Superiority (NEXUS) research group. Research within this group deals with distributed systems, collaboration, coordinated effects, orchestration, and system on systems approaches, amongst many more. The group both drives novel, innovative research ideas and explores how they can transition into larger programs of record and get in the hands of the Warfighter. Missions covered by the group span electronic warfare (EW), radio, signals intelligence (SIGINT), and multi-modal sensemaking and effects, among others. Successful candidates will have prior experience in business capture and customer development as well as leadership across multiple research programs including technical development, customer interaction, program management, or new concept development. Most programs involve teams comprised of strong academic scientists and engineers across multiple disciplines.

The TDD will lead a group of scientists that are responsible for finding and securing new business, executing successfully on current contracts, and transitioning technology for deep mission impacts. A strong component of the group is engaging with external and internal customers to build, win, and execute programs that support the research and development of advanced technology. The TDD is expected to leverage their position, reputation, and technical expertise to build and maintain relationships with government R&D organizations such as DARPA, AFRL, OUSW(R&E), etc. Additionally, the candidate is expected to help define and advance the technical and programmatic roadmaps of the group, directly manage staff, work closely with engineers and other functional support orgs, closely collaborate across adjacent groups and transition pathways, maintain profit & loss targets, and help foster a deeply innovative, collaborative culture.

In This Job Role, Qualified Candidates Can Expect To

Contribute to the successful shaping and capturing new research contracts.
Build and maintain strategic partnerships with government agencies, external companies, and other BAE Systems groups and business areas.
Oversee the execution of research projects.
Pursue personal and portfolio growth to target standing up, managing, and supporting a team of scientists, researchers, and technology developers.
Provide capture and execution oversight of a portfolio of programs valued ~$20M.
Directly manage 10+ scientist staff members.

This position is based out of our Merrimack, NH facility. Because of the need for consistent, in-person collaboration and/or the requirement to perform all work onsite due to the nature of this particular role, it will be performed

full-time on site

. This means work will be conducted on location at a BAE Systems facility 100% of the time.

Required Education, Experience, & Skills

Typically, a bachelor’s degree with greater than 12 years of professional experience, or a master’s degree and greater than 10 years of professional experience or a Doctorate and greater than 8 years of professional experience.
Active DoW Secret clearance with ability to attain DoW Top Secret/SCI clearance.
Strong desire to collaborate with internal/external customers to improve proliferation of technology.

Excellent written and oral communication skills.

Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills

jobs.title: Director of Cloud Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

At Wizards of the Coast, we connect people around the world through play and imagination. From our genre-defining games like Magic: The Gathering® and Dungeons & Dragons® to our growing multiverse, we continue to innovate and build new ways to foster friendship and connection. That’s where you come in!

The Director of Cloud Infrastructure & Engineering leads Hasbro's critical infrastructure transformation: moving completely from on-premises data centers to AWS. This role also involves implementing cloud-native security to enable active detection and response. It is an enterprise-wide position supporting Hasbro and its studios, including Wizards of the Coast.

Reporting to the VP of Infrastructure Engineering and Operations, this is a senior leadership role. You will be responsible for Cloud Platform Engineering, Data Center Services, and Site Reliability Engineering. You will run the associated P&Ls and FinOps subject area. You will also lead the governance model for a rapidly growing AWS environment.

What You'll Do

Cloud Platform, Strategy & Reliability

Define and own the multi-year cloud strategy and roadmap. This includes target-state architecture and hybrid/multi-cloud posture. Establish cloud as an internal product with clear SLAs and a self-service, paved-road platform model.
Own the on-premises to AWS migration end to end, holding the organization accountable to achievements and business outcomes.
Own the retained data centers. Manage planning, contract posture, and daily operations through and beyond the migration. This ensures the hybrid estate runs as one platform, not two.
Lead a customer-first platform organization: develop secure, well-managed, modular elements built to accelerate studio and partner engineering teams,
Establish Site Reliability Engineering as a new field. Define the operating model and charter, then develop it: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call maturity, and DR/BCP for cloud-hosted workloads.

Account Management & Oversight (in collaboration with Cybersecurity)

Own the development and day-to-day operation of the AWS multi-account structure, including organizational units, account vending, and Landing Zone/Control Tower guardrails, as accounts scale through the data center migration.
Define and enforce account lifecycle policies: provisioning, tagging standards, ownership assignment, decommissioning, and access review.
Maintain a governance framework aligned with the AWS Well-Architected Framework, focusing on the Cost Optimization and Security pillars. Audit accounts for drift and collaborate with your teams to address issues.
Own Service Control Policies, tagging enforcement, and account-level compliance reporting as a durable operating approach in this field, not a one-time cleanup.
Collaborate with the Hasbro Cybersecurity and Identity teams to strengthen cloud security posture across guardrails, CSPM, and Defender for Cloud, and advance the implementation of an active SIEM, including analytic rules, KQL detections, and automated response.
Partner with Network and Identity leadership to develop Zero Trust at the cloud edge, integrating user-based policy with cloud network controls.

FinOps & Cost Management

Own the cloud P&L, handling a multi-year program budget.
Establish and lead the FinOps operating rhythm: cost allocation, showback to business units and studio teams, forecasting, and variance reporting.
Be responsible for the lifecycle of commitment-based discounts, including coverage, utilization, and renewal strategy, to improve savings without over-committing.
Establish unit economics for cloud-hosted workloads (cost per environment, per service, per studio) so engineering and business collaborators can understand cost-to-value tradeoffs.
Identify and promote optimization opportunities such as rightsizing, idle resource cleanup, and architecture changes, in collaboration with studio and partner engineering teams.

Vendor & Collaboration Management

Own the AWS partner relationship: enterprise agreement terms, credits, support for blocking issues, and roadmap alignment.
Partner with Finance and Procurement on budget planning, invoice reconciliation, and true-up processes tied to the multi-year migration budget.
Act as the governance and cost point of contact for studio engineering teams.
Serve as the executive-facing owner of cloud, delivering VP reporting on account health, governance posture, and cost trends, with cross-functional roadmap alignment across Identity, Network, Cybersecurity, Finance, Central Tech, and studio engineering.

Team Developement

Build and develop a layer of cloud architects and subject-matter experts across cloud providers, governance, compliance, and security.
Build, mentor, and develop a management and principal engineer layer across Cloud Platform Engineering, Cloud Security Operations, and SRE or equivalent experience; own organizational structure, headcount, hiring, and performance.

What You'll Bring

10+ years of infrastructure and cloud engineering, with 5+ years leading teams, including experience managing managers.
A proven track record owning enterprise-scale AWS environments and delivering a large-scale data center to cloud migration end-to-end.
Deep AWS platform proficiency and demonstrated governance ownership at scale, across Landing Zone, Control Tower, multi-account structure and guardrails, tagging and policy enforcement, Well-Architected-aligned auditing, EKS, cloud networking, and AWS IAM Identity Center.
Demonstrated FinOps leadership, having owned a multi-million-dollar cloud budget and driven measurable unit-cost improvement.
Platform engineering leader with a customer-centered approach, having developed secure and well-controlled reusable components that noticeably improved the teams you assist, in an organization that puts internal customers' needs first rather than directing them.
Experience building and scaling engineering organizations. This includes composing org structure, hiring, and developing leaders below you. You will mature functions that did not previously exist. You have the executive presence to translate infrastructure risk and investment into business language at the VP level.
A security-forward approach, having partnered with cybersecurity and identity organizations to harden a cloud estate and operationalize detection and response.

NICE TO HAVE

AWS Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional; FinOps Certified Professional.
Practical experience in implementing Microsoft Sentinel and Defender for Cloud.
Site Reliability Engineering organization expansion focusing on SLOs, error budgets, and on-call maturity.
Exposure to Zero Trust and SASE architectures and cloud access based on user verification.
Experience in a multi-studio, multi-BU entertainment or gaming enterprise environment.

jobs.description:
Patients with mitral and tricuspid heart valve disease often have complex conditions with limited treatment options. Our Transcatheter Mitral and Tricuspid Therapies (TMTT) business unit is boldly pursuing an innovative portfolio of technologies to address a patient’s unmet clinical needs. It’s our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey.

Innovation starts from the heart. At Edwards, we put patients first. We invest a significant proportion of our revenue towards research and development to drive and develop groundbreaking medical innovations for structural heart disease. As part of our R&D Engineering team, you will work closely with our Quality and Manufacturing teams to develop the latest tools and technologies to address significant, unmet clinical needs that impact patients’ lives around the world.

How you will make an impact:

Edwards Lifesciences is seeking a highly experienced technical leader to serve as Director, Systems Engineering - SaMD
within the Transcatheter Mitral and Tricuspid Therapies (TMTT) organization.

This role will serve as the future technical owner of a next-generation software-enabled capital equipment platform and associated digital technologies supporting advanced structural heart therapies.

The successful candidate will provide systems leadership, architecture oversight, and technical ownership across the product lifecycle while partnering with geographically distributed engineering teams, OEM suppliers, and cross-functional stakeholders. This individual will influence technical strategy, system design, architecture decisions, product development execution, integration approaches, technical tradeoffs, risk management activities, and overall platform evolution.

This is not a traditional people-management role or a process-oriented systems engineering position. It is a Director-level technical leadership role intended for an experienced product builder who has personally developed and commercialized complex capital equipment, Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), or other software-enabled products and can apply that experience to evaluate architecture, technical strategy, resource needs, schedules, risks, and overall program execution.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong executive presence and can influence multidisciplinary organizations without direct authority. This role is an individual contributor initially, with the opportunity to build future systems engineering and integration capabilities as technical ownership transitions to Irvine and platform needs evolve.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead end-to-end integration of a software-enabled capital equipment platform and associated digital technologies, ensuring alignment across hardware, electronics, firmware, software, Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), connectivity solutions, and user interfaces.
Drive technical execution throughout the product lifecycle by evaluating system requirements, architecture, development plans, verification strategies, schedules, staffing assumptions, and overall program readiness.
Identify and resolve system-level issues, integration risks, and execution gaps to support successful product development, commercialization, and long-term product performance.
Serve as the technical leader and systems architecture authority for the platform, guiding system design, architecture development, technical decision-making, and long-term platform evolution while establishing technical ownership within the Irvine organization.
Ensure architecture, requirements, and design decisions align with user needs, clinical workflows, human factors principles, regulatory expectations, cybersecurity requirements, and long-term business objectives.
Apply systems thinking and Design for Excellence (DFX) principles when evaluating architecture, integration, and product decisions, balancing performance, reliability, quality, manufacturability, serviceability, supply chain considerations, cost, product lifecycle requirements, and commercialization readiness.
Lead knowledge-transfer and ownership-transition activities from geographically distributed development teams while preserving technical knowledge, design intent, and architecture rationale.
Partner with OEM suppliers, external development organizations, and internal stakeholders to ensure technical alignment, successful execution, and sustainable long-term platform support.
Influence technical direction across Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Manufacturing, Operations, Program Leadership, and external partners.
Communicate technical recommendations, risks, tradeoffs, and program health to engineering teams, functional leaders, and executive leadership while operating as a trusted technical authority who leads through expertise, credibility, collaboration, and sound engineering judgment.

This is a fully on-site role based at our corporate headquarters in Irvine, CA.

What you'll need (Required):

Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Computer, Software, Biomedical, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with 12 years of experience or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria
Significant hands-on experience developing and commercializing capital equipment, Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), reusable electronic platforms, digital health technologies, or other complex software-enabled products.
Deep technical expertise in one or more of the following: software development and architecture; SaMD; embedded systems and firmware; electronics and electrical systems; systems architecture and integration; or digital and connected technologies.
Demonstrated experience integrating hardware, firmware, software, user interfaces, connectivity solutions, and associated system components into commercial products.
Proven experience serving as a technical lead, systems architect, Chief Engineer, systems engineering leader, or comparable technical authority.
Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical strategies, architecture decisions, development plans, staffing models, schedules, integration approaches, and program risks based on direct product-development experience.
Demonstrated experience applying Design for Excellence principles, including Design for Reliability, Design for Manufacturability and Assembly, Design for Testability, and Design for Serviceability.
Demonstrated systems-thinking capability with experience making complex technical and architectural tradeoffs across software, firmware, electronics, reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, quality, cost, and regulatory requirements.
Experience applying design controls, requirements management, risk management, and verification and validation practices in a regulated environment.
Working knowledge of IEC 60601 and its application to medical electrical equipment development.
Demonstrated success influencing multidisciplinary and geographically distributed organizations without direct reporting authority.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
Ability to travel approximately 10–20%, including domestic and international travel.

What else we look for (Preferred):

Master's Degree or equivalent in Electrical, Computer, Software, Biomedical, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, with 10 years of experience
Medical device development experience, including Class II and/or Class III products.
Significant experience developing, commercializing, or supporting SaMD, digital health technologies, connected medical systems, cloud-enabled healthcare platforms, or software-enabled clinical products.
Experience developing capital equipment platforms used in clinical environments.
Experience with diagnostic, therapeutic, robotic, imaging, patient-monitoring, or other reusable electronic medical technologies.
Experience leading architecture and integration activities across software, firmware, electronics, and complex electromechanical systems.
Experience incorporating clinical needs, human factors principles, and user-centered design methodologies into product development.
Experience supporting technology transfer, technical ownership transitions, or organizational capability-building initiatives.
Experience working with geographically distributed engineering organizations and external development or manufacturing partners.
Experience supporting product lifecycle management, including sustaining engineering, software maintenance, platform evolution, cybersecurity updates, serviceability, and end-of-life planning
Working knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 14971, medical device cybersecurity, human factors engineering, and regulatory submission support.
Adhere to all company rules and requirements (e.g., pandemic protocols, Environmental Health & Safety rules) and take adequate control measures in preventing injuries to themselves and others as well as to the protection of environment and prevention of pollution under their span of influence/control

jobs.title: Head of Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Lazard is one of the world’s preeminent financial advisory and asset management firms. Our people and culture make the difference.
While global in presence and reach, ours is a close, collaborative community of just over 3,000 professionals. Lazard is a place of continuous knowledge sharing, skill development and relationship building, where professionals grow and succeed together. Our entrepreneurial culture, flat structure and embrace of individual differences, allow creative ideas, original concepts, and unique perspectives to drive our business forward — and for careers to take flight.

Lazard Asset Management (LAM) is seeking a Head of Data Engineering to lead the ground-up modernization of its data landscape. This is a rare build mandate: replace a fragmented legacy estate with a governed, cloud-native data service platform that turns data into a reusable, on-demand asset and accelerates the firm’s ability to adopt AI, empower self-service, and integrate new capabilities through a plug-and-play architecture. Working hand in hand with business and shared service teams and the central AI and Data team, you will define and deliver a new end-to-end data strategy, from business needs through to shared infrastructure.

You are a senior data platform leader from asset management or a comparable regulated financial institution who has modernized complex legacy environments without disrupting production. You pair the architectural vision to set direction with the hands-on depth to earn credibility with engineers.

We'll Trust You To

Define and own LAM's end-to-end data strategy, from business priorities and use cases through data products, platforms, and shared infrastructure, co-designing solutions with investment, distribution, and operations teams to deliver measurable outcomes
Partner with the central AI and Data team to reuse firmwide platforms, models, and data products, adopt enterprise data standards, and integrate cleanly into the broader Lazard data ecosystem
Own the multi-year roadmap to retire legacy databases, on-premises infrastructure, and fragile ETL, rebuilding LAM's data estate on a modern cloud-native foundation
Execute production-safe migrations (phased cutovers, parallel runs, automated reconciliation, rollback plans) and report progress, value, and risk to technology and business leadership
Define the target architecture (ingestion, lakehouse storage, transformation, serving, observability) and build a data service platform with well-defined data products, published SLAs, and API-first consumption
Design a modular, plug-and-play architecture on open standards so tools, vendors, and data sources can be swapped quickly and at low cost; set canonical data models, metadata standards, and data contracts, and own the data engineering toolchains
Stand up and run a new DataOps function that automates critical processes (ingestion, reconciliation, data quality, distribution, reporting) with orchestration, monitoring, alerting, SLAs, and runbooks
Track and improve operational KPIs (timeliness, accuracy, availability) and report performance to business stakeholders
Make AI-ready data a platform default (trusted, documented, lineage-tracked datasets for training, backtesting, retrieval, and inference) and enable governed self-service via a data catalog, semantic layer, and discoverable data products, replacing shadow pipelines and one-off extracts
Embed security and governance by design (RBAC/ABAC, classification, encryption, masking, lineage, data quality SLOs); meet financial services regulatory requirements and act as control owner for audits and exams, partnering with InfoSec, Risk, and Compliance
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing data engineering team, instilling production-first discipline: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, observability, and incident management

You'll Need To Have

15+ years in data engineering, platform engineering, or data architecture, including 5+ years in senior leadership
Proven record modernizing legacy data estates (e.g., Oracle, Sybase, PostgreSQL) across multiple business lines at an asset manager, investment bank, or similarly regulated financial institution
Experience building enterprise-scale, cloud-native data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) with full ownership of technology decisions, and deep expertise in modern architecture (lakehouse and medallion design, streaming and batch, data products, APIs) and platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, and Collibra
Hands-on credibility in Python, SQL, and enterprise orchestration and transformation tooling, with experience running a DataOps function (pipeline automation, observability, automated data quality testing, infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform)
Track record delivering data foundations for AI/ML and governed self-service analytics
Strong command of data security, governance, and regulatory obligations (SEC, FINRA, GDPR, CCPA, records retention)
Exceptional communicator who has partnered with business, shared service, and central AI and data teams to execute enterprise data strategy and translate technical vision into business outcomes
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

It's a Bonus To Have

Asset management data domain expertise: portfolio, market, reference, client, performance, and risk data
Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented ownership, and with catalog and API tooling (e.g., Collibra, Atlan, Azure API Management)
Exposure to GenAI data patterns such as feature stores, vector databases, and LLM data pipelines
Relevant certifications (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP data/architect certifications, CDMP)

What We Offer

We strive to enhance the total health and well-being of our employees through comprehensive, competitive benefits. Our goal is to offer a highly individualized employee experience that enables you to balance your commitments to career, family, and community. When you work for Lazard, you are working for an organization that cares about your unique talents and passions, and will continue to invest in the development of your career.

We expect the base salary range for this role to be approximately $200,000 - $250,000 USD. Various factors contribute to determining the actual base compensation offered, including but not limited to the applicant’s years of relevant experience, career tenure, qualifications, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and relevant skills for the role. Base salary is one component of Lazard’s compensation package, which also includes comprehensive benefits and may include incentive compensation.

Does this sound like you?

Apply! We’ll get in touch on the next steps.

Representation at Lazard

Lazard is an intellectual capital business committed to delivering the best advice and solutions to clients. To achieve these objectives, we focus on attracting, developing and retaining the best talent. We believe that a workforce comprised of people who represent a wide array of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives creates a rich variety of thought that empowers us to challenge conventional wisdom, solve problems creatively and make better decisions.

Lazard was built on the premise that a multicultural firm can best serve a global clientele. As a global firm that has grown organically from local roots in different countries, we have a deep tradition of respecting and appreciating individual differences. Doing so has been core to our success for over 175 years. jobs.title: Head of Validation and Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
Join the team bringing advanced autonomy to the built world

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and into the real world. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.

We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.

We are seeking a Head of Validation and Systems Engineering
to lead validation, verification, and systems engineering as an integrated discipline. In this role, you will define the criteria for every unsupervised deployment and serve as the technical authority on readiness, participating in critical launch decisions. You will develop a validation architecture where adding a new machine or capability is an incremental, evidence-based process. Rather than inheriting old frameworks, you will leverage cutting-edge research and create new best practices for an emerging industry.

Our machines already operate unsupervised at customer sites. Everything ahead—introducing more machine types, tackling new tasks each quarter, expanding to new sites—pushes the boundaries of the safety standards that have brought us this far.

What you will own

Safety validation of the system. Design the metrics, scenario libraries, and architectural coverage that quantify end-to-end behavioral safety — and make them hold up as the machine set and task set expand.
A validation architecture that generalizes. Decide what evidence is platform-independent and what must be re-established per machine, per task, per site. Turn the safety case into something composable instead of something rewritten.
Systems engineering. Own requirements decomposition and traceability from mission-level intent through subsystems, and use validation findings to expose the gaps, ambiguities, and conflicts that feed back into design.
V&V strategy and infrastructure. Choose the right instrument for each claim — log playback, closed-loop physics simulation, structured proving-ground testing, or on-site work — and specify the tooling and sim capability needed to make those instruments trustworthy across a growing fleet.
Hardware and functional safety. Validate the sensing, compute, and actuation kit we install on customer machines, including functional-safety readiness of safety-critical paths, as that kit is ported onto new platforms.
The org. Grow a team of software, systems, test, and hardware engineers plus data scientists, and scale it ahead of the machine count rather than behind it.
Decision-grade reporting. Define the KPIs — verification coverage, defect trends, release readiness, system maturity — and turn dense test data into the small number of charts that let leadership, customers, and insurers make a call.

What the first year looks like

A V&V framework and safety case structure that spans multiple machine types and an expanding task set, and that engineering, customers, and insurers all recognize as rigorous.
A scenario and coverage model built for the machines and tasks we have not shipped yet, not just the ones we have.
Readiness criteria that generalize — so the second platform, and the tenth, clear the bar faster than the first did without clearing a lower one.
A team that outlives any single launch.

Background

BS or advanced degree in engineering, physics, or another technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years in test planning and experimental design for safety-critical autonomous or robotic systems, with a bias toward safety and repeatability.
Track record building and leading multidisciplinary technical organizations — software, systems, hardware, test, and data science under one roof.
Depth in sensing and compute: cameras, lidar, radar, GNSS, IMUs, edge compute, embedded controllers.
Fluency in data analysis and test automation (Python, C/C++) sufficient to interrogate results yourself, not only to review them.
Experience running many parallel test activities across non-colocated teams, sites, and stakeholders.
Judgment about when a claim is proven and when it merely looks proven.

Ways to stand out

You have taken a driverless or unsupervised system through to real deployment and personally held the readiness gate — and then had to do it again for a second platform.
You have scaled a validation program across a heterogeneous fleet, multiple sites, or successive hardware generations.
You have authored or led a formal safety case, or contributed to safety standards work (UL 4600, ISO 26262, ISO 21448, or off-road equivalents).
Functional safety experience on vertically integrated or custom hardware.
Familiarity with heavy construction machines — excavators, articulated dump trucks, dozers, wheel loaders, motor graders.
A record of external technical contribution: publications, keynotes, standards bodies, or research leadership. We want this role visible in the field, and we will support that.

How we work

We are a startup, so we look for engineers with an appetite for agility. We do not compromise on safety and we still find ways to move extremely fast — the entire point of this role is that those two things are compatible when the evidence is good enough.

leads one or more Digital Engineering teams responsible for designing, building, testing, releasing, and transitioning digital healthcare solutions across Epic and non‑Epic platforms that deliver measurable value to patients, clinicians, caregivers, and operational users. This role ensures alignment with enterprise architecture standards, Digital Engineering capabilities, and operating model practices while driving delivery across the full product lifecycle—from technical feasibility and design through build, testing, release, and transition to support. This role partners closely with Product, UX, Architecture, QA, Data, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and platform teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, and operationally ready.

Strategy

Execute Digital Engineering strategies aligned to product roadmaps, capability models, and Agile delivery principles.
Translate enterprise and Digital priorities into delivery plans, capacity forecasts, and execution commitments.
Align engineering efforts with patient and user value outcomes.
Contribute to roadmap planning, prioritization, and delivery sequencing.

Engineering Delivery

Support Agile delivery across design, build, test, deployment, and transition-to-support phases.
Ensure solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, security, usability, and accessibility.
Oversee development, integration, and testing activities across Epic and non-Epic platforms.
Ensure release readiness, operational stability, compliance, and knowledge transfer.
Support production validation, stabilization, and transition-to-support activities through documentation and runbooks.
Manage technical risks, dependencies, and feasibility considerations.

Quality Engineering & Release Readiness

Partner with QA and Test Engineering teams to embed quality throughout the product lifecycle.
Ensure functional, regression, user acceptance, and non-functional testing activities are completed.
Advance adoption of test automation, quality frameworks, and engineering metrics.
Monitor defect trends, release stability, test coverage, and overall production readiness.

Agile & DevOps Leadership

Support self-organizing teams through servant leadership and continuous improvement practices.
Monitor sprint commitments, delivery metrics, capacity planning, and resource allocation.
Collaborate with Product, UX, Architecture, Deployment, Managed Services, and Technology teams.
Collaborate and support Agile Center of Excellence
Align delivery to operating model phases
Promote DevOps and support operational readiness, runbooks, documentation, and transition-to-support activities
Drive continuous improvement in tools, processes, practices and capability maturity

Leadership & Team Development

Coach, and develop engineering staff, consultants, and vendors with the Agile framework.
Build high-performing teams through individual development, mentoring, skills development, and career planning.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, continuous learning, and patient focus.

What We Require

Education

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field; or equivalent experience.

Experience

7-8 years of experience in digital engineering, software development, application delivery, healthcare technology, or related technical disciplines.
4+ years of experience working in Epic Application modules, particularly Digital such as MyChart, Ambulatory, ClinDoc, Cadence, Care Companion, Provider Finder, Hello World, Chart with Art (digital scribe), etc.
Experience delivering patient-facing, clinician-facing, Epic, and digital healthcare solutions.

About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Corporate IT organization is on a transformational journey to redefine how enterprise technology enables global business scale, resilience, and employee productivity. We are moving beyond traditional infrastructure models toward software-defined, automated, cloud-integrated platforms that deliver security, reliability, and exceptional user experience at global scale.

The Senior Director, Corporate Network & Infrastructure will play a critical role in modernizing Visa’s global corporate network and infrastructure platforms—driving reliability, security, and performance while enabling hybrid work, cloud adoption, and digital-first business operations.

Key Focus Areas

Enterprise resilience and availability at global scale — designing and running services that are reliable, secure, and easy to operate.
Modernization and simplification — shifting toward software-defined, automated, and cloud-integrated network and infrastructure capabilities.

Security and risk-by-design — embedding controls, compliance, and cyber resiliency into architecture and operations.

Attract, retain, and grow talent through intentional development, succession planning, and high-performance expectations.

12+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor's degree, OR 15+ years of relevant work experience.

Experience in taking ownership of complex, multi-faceted, open-ended problems and driving them to completion.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering and Delivery
jobs.description:
Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM
is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering & Delivery, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing how software is built, tested, secured, packaged, and delivered across SiriusXM. You will lead the Delivery team while remaining actively engaged in architecture, engineering design, prototyping, technical reviews, and solving complex delivery challenges alongside the engineers you lead.

You will also be advancing Agentic Delivery
: evolving our software delivery platform so AI agents can perform increasingly complex parts of the software development lifecycle—including coding, testing, validation, remediation, and delivery—based on human direction and within well-defined engineering, security, and operational guardrails. You will help define the architecture, platform capabilities, standards, and controls required to make agent-driven software delivery safe, reliable, observable, and scalable across the enterprise.

You will also own and evolve the foundational delivery capabilities that engineering teams and agents depend on, including CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain security, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Your goal will be to create a delivery platform that makes the secure and reliable path the easiest path, whether the work is being performed by a human engineer, an AI agent, or a combination of both.

This is a player-coach role. You will provide people leadership and strategic direction, but you will also be expected to stay close to the technology, evaluate and improve technical designs, contribute to technical solutions, and directly help move important initiatives forward.

What You’ll Do

Lead the evolution toward Agentic Delivery: Define and execute the technical strategy for enabling AI agents to safely perform software delivery work based on human intent. Build the platform capabilities, APIs, workflows, context, permissions, feedback loops, and guardrails needed for agents to write code, run tests, remediate issues, validate changes, and progress software through delivery workflows.
Remain hands-on technically: Work directly with engineers on architecture, system design, prototypes, technical investigations, and complex implementation challenges. Review code and designs where appropriate, validate technical approaches, and help establish reference implementations for new delivery capabilities.
Own the software delivery architecture: Set technical direction across CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain controls, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Ensure these capabilities work together as a coherent delivery platform rather than as disconnected tools.
Design for both human and agent consumers: Evolve delivery systems so workflows can be used consistently through developer interfaces, APIs, automation, and AI agents. Ensure delivery capabilities expose the context, controls, telemetry, and machine-readable interfaces required for increasingly autonomous engineering workflows.
Create secure, reusable paved paths: Develop and drive adoption of standardized delivery patterns that reduce one-off implementations, improve developer productivity, and embed security, compliance, reliability, and observability into the default workflow.
Advance CI/CD and release engineering: Improve development feedback loops, pipeline performance, release reliability, and consistency across engineering teams. Identify bottlenecks and use automation, platform engineering, and AI where appropriate to remove unnecessary manual work.
Strengthen software supply chain security: Partner with Information Security to integrate code scanning, dependency controls, artifact integrity, vulnerability management, provenance, policy enforcement, and other secure-by-default controls directly into CI pipelines and delivery workflows.
Standardize artifacts: Establish scalable patterns for how packages and build outputs are created, secured, stored, promoted, traced, and consumed across environments.
Use engineering data to drive improvement: Establish metrics around pipeline performance, adoption, failure rates, developer wait time, release reliability, agent effectiveness, remediation outcomes, and other delivery signals. Use those metrics to prioritize platform improvements and measure their impact.
Lead and develop the Delivery team: Provide clear technical and organizational direction, coach engineers and technical leads, build leadership capability, manage performance, and create an environment where engineers can take meaningful ownership of complex platform problems.
Drive cross-functional technical alignment: Work closely with Developer Experience, Cloud, Observability, Information Security, application engineering, and other stakeholders to solve cross-cutting delivery problems and establish common engineering standards.
Own roadmap and investment decisions: Translate engineering and business needs into a prioritized roadmap, balancing strategic platform investment, operational reliability, technical debt, developer productivity, security, and cost.
Evaluate emerging technologies pragmatically: Continuously assess new approaches in AI-assisted development, agentic engineering, CI/CD, software supply chain security, and developer tooling. Prototype where appropriate and turn successful experiments into production-grade platform capabilities.

What You’ll Need

Typically 7 or more years of software engineering or platform engineering experience, including 3 or more years leading engineering teams or technical organizations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong hands-on technical background. You should be comfortable going deep on architecture, reviewing technical designs, reading and reviewing code, building prototypes, debugging complex systems, and working directly with engineers to solve difficult platform problems.
Experience designing modern software delivery systems, with strong knowledge of one or more of the following: CI/CD platforms, GitHub Actions or similar workflow systems, artifact repositories, developer tooling, code quality platforms, software supply chain security, or security scanning in CI pipelines.
Strong software engineering skills. Experience designing and building production software, automation, APIs, platform services, or developer tooling in one or more modern programming languages.
Experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development. Understanding of how coding agents, LLM-based engineering tools, tool-calling agents, or similar systems can participate in the software development lifecycle. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is strongly preferred.
Ability to reason about the architecture of Agentic Delivery systems, including context and tool access, permissions, human approval points, policy enforcement, isolation, auditability, observability, feedback loops, and safe execution of autonomous actions.
Deep understanding of CI/CD and software delivery architecture, including build and test automation, security scanning in CI pipelines, release workflows, artifact promotion, environment management, deployment patterns, and the operational concerns associated with running these systems at enterprise scale.
Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including secure build practices, dependency and vulnerability management, artifact integrity, provenance, policy enforcement, and shifting security controls earlier in the development lifecycle through CI pipelines.
Strong cloud and platform engineering fundamentals, preferably with experience operating large-scale systems on AWS and working with infrastructure-as-code and distributed systems.
Technical leadership and judgment. Ability to make architecture decisions, evaluate technical designs and trade-offs, identify where standardization creates leverage, balance short- and long-term considerations, and guide engineers through ambiguous technical problems.
People leadership. Proven ability to coach and develop engineers and technical leads, manage performance, build healthy teams, delegate effectively, and develop future technical and organizational leaders.
Cross-functional influence. Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, security, product, and senior leadership; communicate complex technical topics clearly; and drive adoption of standards across teams you do not directly manage.
Operational and product mindset. Ability to treat internal platform capabilities as products, measure adoption and outcomes, understand developer needs, prioritize based on impact, and continuously improve the experience of engineers using the platform.
Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $106,600 to $200,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

Our goal at SiriusXM is to provide and maintain a work environment that fosters mutual respect, professionalism and cooperation. jobs.title: Senior Director of Cybersecurity Strategy, Architecture & Engineering
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Delaware North is hiring a full-time Senior Director of Cybersecurity Strategy, Architecture & Engineering to join our team at our global headquarters in Buffalo, New York. The Director of Cyber Security Strategy, Architecture, & Engineering is at the forefront of developing and implementing the overarching cybersecurity framework that aligns with the enterprise's strategic vision. This role is critical in crafting robust security architectures and engineering solutions that integrate seamlessly with corporate systems, including Single Sign-On (SSO) capabilities. The director drives security initiatives from conceptualization to deployment, ensuring the advancement of the company’s cyber defenses in a dynamic threat landscape.

If you’re passionate about Cybersecurity, and want a role where collaboration, technical expertise, and results are valued, we encourage you to apply.

Pay

Minimum – Anticipated Maximum Base Salary: $157,400 - $212,500 / year

In addition to base salary, we offer an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. The advertised pay range represents what we believe at the time of this job posting, that we would be willing to pay for this position. Only in special circumstances, where a candidate has education, training, or experience that far exceeds the requirements for the position, would we consider paying higher than the stated range. Information on our comprehensive benefits package can be found at https://careers.delawarenorth.com/benefits/.

What We Offer

At Delaware North, we care about our team members' personal and professional journeys. These are just some of the benefits we offer:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) with up to 4% company match
Annual performance bonus based on level, as well as individual, company, and location performance
Paid vacation days and holidays
Paid parental bonding leave
Tuition and/or professional certification reimbursement
Generous friends-and-family discounts at many of our hotels and resorts

What will you do?

Develop and implement a cybersecurity strategy that aligns with the company's overall business goals and risk management framework
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of cybersecurity engineers, promoting a culture of professional growth, operational excellence, and innovation
Architect security infrastructure and consult with solutions owners to ensure that security designs are aligned with business needs

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - RL Post-Training Frameworks
jobs.description:
Can you bring together globally distributed teams and the systems they build into a production-quality reinforcement learning ecosystem for researchers and model builders? Reinforcement learning post-training is where modern AI systems learn to reason, use tools, follow detailed instructions, and act as agents. Making that capability work at scale creates one of the most demanding systems problems in AI: a single RL run ties together inference, rollout, reward and critic evaluation, and training. At frontier scale, these loops have to run reliably across GPUs, CPUs, networking, storage, and open-source runtimes. You will lead the work to build, extend, and harden the rapidly evolving pieces to compose cleanly and scale with the most ambitious RL projects on NVIDIA's platforms.

To meet that challenge, NVIDIA is building an RL Frameworks engineering team for the open-source tools and infrastructure that researchers, model builders, and external partners depend on. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to set strategy, build the team, and convert emerging technical, customer, and partner signals into clear engineering priorities. The role spans RL frameworks such as VeRL, Miles, Slime, SkyRL, TorchTitan, and related post-training stacks, along with the systems those stacks build on and compose with: Megatron-Core, Ray, Monarch, NIXL, SGLang, Kubernetes, and NVIDIA platform libraries. Come build the ecosystem that the next generation of AI will rely on!

What You Will Be Doing

You will own NVIDIA's RL post-training frameworks strategy: where we invest directly, where we partner upstream, and how we prioritize based on customer impact, ecosystem leverage, technical feasibility, and opportunity cost. This is senior technical leadership work: using systems depth to evaluate architecture and performance claims across training, inference, rollout, orchestration, and the NVIDIA platform. You will help expert teams converge on integrations that improve RL framework quality and user value, then turn those decisions into measurable execution plans. The work includes benchmarking and reproducibility criteria, delivery across open-source frameworks and distributed runtimes, and close partnership with product management, research, DevRel, customer-facing teams, hardware, CUDA, networking, math libraries, compilers, and external open-source collaborators.

You will also build the team: recruiting and developing managers and senior ICs, creating an effective US/APAC operating model, reviewing capacity against commitments, and setting clear ownership and decision rights. You will coach engineers to contribute credibly in open-source ecosystems and carry NVIDIA's priorities through high-quality upstream work. Because the technical work crosses organizations by design, you will turn open technical and partner questions into concrete and measurable action, set delivery goals, and hold the quality bar. Success means validated, valuable work rather than work that merely lands, plus durable open-source improvements that make RL workloads run well on NVIDIA systems.

What We Need To See

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
10+ years of software engineering experience in distributed systems, AI frameworks, ML infrastructure, high-performance computing, or systems software, with 4+ years as an engineering manager for software teams
Strong technical background in distributed AI systems, including the ability to reason across training, inference, orchestration, and end-to-end performance, and challenge architecture and performance tradeoffs with senior engineers
Experience defining domain-level technical strategy, making build-vs-buy or upstream-vs-internal investment decisions, and creating multi-team execution plans
Ability to drive engineering work across organizational boundaries, influence without direct authority, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders and executives
Experience hiring and leading engineering teams, developing technical leaders or new managers, and creating staffing plans for constantly evolving technical domains
Experience establishing workflows, success criteria, metrics, or decision gates that improve engineering execution across teams
Background collaborating with open-source communities, research teams, external partners, or customer-facing teams

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Hands-on experience with RL post-training frameworks or algorithms such as RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, reward modeling, VeRL, Miles, Slime, SkyRL, OpenRLHF, NeMo-Aligner, or TorchTitan
Background with runtime and orchestration systems such as Ray, Monarch, Kubernetes, Slurm, or comparable actor- and task-based systems
Experience scaling workloads across thousands of GPUs or heterogeneous systems, including fault tolerance, elastic recovery, stragglers, resource contention, or benchmark reproducibility
Familiarity with NVIDIA platform components such as CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN, TensorRT-LLM, Transformer Engine, Nsight, NeMo, or Megatron-Core
Demonstrated ability to turn customer or partner needs into reusable upstream improvements rather than one-off support

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 29, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
