jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering and Delivery
jobs.description:
Who We Are

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM
is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How You’ll Make An Impact

As Senior Manager, Platform Engineering & Delivery, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing how software is built, tested, secured, packaged, and delivered across SiriusXM. You will lead the Delivery team while remaining actively engaged in architecture, engineering design, prototyping, technical reviews, and solving complex delivery challenges alongside the engineers you lead.

You will also be advancing Agentic Delivery
: evolving our software delivery platform so AI agents can perform increasingly complex parts of the software development lifecycle—including coding, testing, validation, remediation, and delivery—based on human direction and within well-defined engineering, security, and operational guardrails. You will help define the architecture, platform capabilities, standards, and controls required to make agent-driven software delivery safe, reliable, observable, and scalable across the enterprise.

You will also own and evolve the foundational delivery capabilities that engineering teams and agents depend on, including CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain security, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Your goal will be to create a delivery platform that makes the secure and reliable path the easiest path, whether the work is being performed by a human engineer, an AI agent, or a combination of both.

This is a player-coach role. You will provide people leadership and strategic direction, but you will also be expected to stay close to the technology, evaluate and improve technical designs, contribute to technical solutions, and directly help move important initiatives forward.

What You’ll Do

Lead the evolution toward Agentic Delivery: Define and execute the technical strategy for enabling AI agents to safely perform software delivery work based on human intent. Build the platform capabilities, APIs, workflows, context, permissions, feedback loops, and guardrails needed for agents to write code, run tests, remediate issues, validate changes, and progress software through delivery workflows.
Remain hands-on technically: Work directly with engineers on architecture, system design, prototypes, technical investigations, and complex implementation challenges. Review code and designs where appropriate, validate technical approaches, and help establish reference implementations for new delivery capabilities.
Own the software delivery architecture: Set technical direction across CI/CD, artifact management, code quality, software supply chain controls, and security scanning in CI pipelines. Ensure these capabilities work together as a coherent delivery platform rather than as disconnected tools.
Design for both human and agent consumers: Evolve delivery systems so workflows can be used consistently through developer interfaces, APIs, automation, and AI agents. Ensure delivery capabilities expose the context, controls, telemetry, and machine-readable interfaces required for increasingly autonomous engineering workflows.
Create secure, reusable paved paths: Develop and drive adoption of standardized delivery patterns that reduce one-off implementations, improve developer productivity, and embed security, compliance, reliability, and observability into the default workflow.
Advance CI/CD and release engineering: Improve development feedback loops, pipeline performance, release reliability, and consistency across engineering teams. Identify bottlenecks and use automation, platform engineering, and AI where appropriate to remove unnecessary manual work.
Strengthen software supply chain security: Partner with Information Security to integrate code scanning, dependency controls, artifact integrity, vulnerability management, provenance, policy enforcement, and other secure-by-default controls directly into CI pipelines and delivery workflows.
Standardize artifacts: Establish scalable patterns for how packages and build outputs are created, secured, stored, promoted, traced, and consumed across environments.
Use engineering data to drive improvement: Establish metrics around pipeline performance, adoption, failure rates, developer wait time, release reliability, agent effectiveness, remediation outcomes, and other delivery signals. Use those metrics to prioritize platform improvements and measure their impact.
Lead and develop the Delivery team: Provide clear technical and organizational direction, coach engineers and technical leads, build leadership capability, manage performance, and create an environment where engineers can take meaningful ownership of complex platform problems.
Drive cross-functional technical alignment: Work closely with Developer Experience, Cloud, Observability, Information Security, application engineering, and other stakeholders to solve cross-cutting delivery problems and establish common engineering standards.
Own roadmap and investment decisions: Translate engineering and business needs into a prioritized roadmap, balancing strategic platform investment, operational reliability, technical debt, developer productivity, security, and cost.
Evaluate emerging technologies pragmatically: Continuously assess new approaches in AI-assisted development, agentic engineering, CI/CD, software supply chain security, and developer tooling. Prototype where appropriate and turn successful experiments into production-grade platform capabilities.

What You’ll Need

Typically 7 or more years of software engineering or platform engineering experience, including 3 or more years leading engineering teams or technical organizations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong hands-on technical background. You should be comfortable going deep on architecture, reviewing technical designs, reading and reviewing code, building prototypes, debugging complex systems, and working directly with engineers to solve difficult platform problems.
Experience designing modern software delivery systems, with strong knowledge of one or more of the following: CI/CD platforms, GitHub Actions or similar workflow systems, artifact repositories, developer tooling, code quality platforms, software supply chain security, or security scanning in CI pipelines.
Strong software engineering skills. Experience designing and building production software, automation, APIs, platform services, or developer tooling in one or more modern programming languages.
Experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development. Understanding of how coding agents, LLM-based engineering tools, tool-calling agents, or similar systems can participate in the software development lifecycle. Experience building or integrating agentic workflows is strongly preferred.
Ability to reason about the architecture of Agentic Delivery systems, including context and tool access, permissions, human approval points, policy enforcement, isolation, auditability, observability, feedback loops, and safe execution of autonomous actions.
Deep understanding of CI/CD and software delivery architecture, including build and test automation, security scanning in CI pipelines, release workflows, artifact promotion, environment management, deployment patterns, and the operational concerns associated with running these systems at enterprise scale.
Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including secure build practices, dependency and vulnerability management, artifact integrity, provenance, policy enforcement, and shifting security controls earlier in the development lifecycle through CI pipelines.
Strong cloud and platform engineering fundamentals, preferably with experience operating large-scale systems on AWS and working with infrastructure-as-code and distributed systems.
Technical leadership and judgment. Ability to make architecture decisions, evaluate technical designs and trade-offs, identify where standardization creates leverage, balance short- and long-term considerations, and guide engineers through ambiguous technical problems.
People leadership. Proven ability to coach and develop engineers and technical leads, manage performance, build healthy teams, delegate effectively, and develop future technical and organizational leaders.
Cross-functional influence. Ability to work effectively with engineering, infrastructure, security, product, and senior leadership; communicate complex technical topics clearly; and drive adoption of standards across teams you do not directly manage.
Operational and product mindset. Ability to treat internal platform capabilities as products, measure adoption and outcomes, understand developer needs, prioritize based on impact, and continuously improve the experience of engineers using the platform.
Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $106,600 to $200,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - RL Post-Training Frameworks
jobs.description:
Can you bring together globally distributed teams and the systems they build into a production-quality reinforcement learning ecosystem for researchers and model builders? Reinforcement learning post-training is where modern AI systems learn to reason, use tools, follow detailed instructions, and act as agents. Making that capability work at scale creates one of the most demanding systems problems in AI: a single RL run ties together inference, rollout, reward and critic evaluation, and training. At frontier scale, these loops have to run reliably across GPUs, CPUs, networking, storage, and open-source runtimes. You will lead the work to build, extend, and harden the rapidly evolving pieces to compose cleanly and scale with the most ambitious RL projects on NVIDIA's platforms.

To meet that challenge, NVIDIA is building an RL Frameworks engineering team for the open-source tools and infrastructure that researchers, model builders, and external partners depend on. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to set strategy, build the team, and convert emerging technical, customer, and partner signals into clear engineering priorities. The role spans RL frameworks such as VeRL, Miles, Slime, SkyRL, TorchTitan, and related post-training stacks, along with the systems those stacks build on and compose with: Megatron-Core, Ray, Monarch, NIXL, SGLang, Kubernetes, and NVIDIA platform libraries. Come build the ecosystem that the next generation of AI will rely on!

What You Will Be Doing

You will own NVIDIA's RL post-training frameworks strategy: where we invest directly, where we partner upstream, and how we prioritize based on customer impact, ecosystem leverage, technical feasibility, and opportunity cost. This is senior technical leadership work: using systems depth to evaluate architecture and performance claims across training, inference, rollout, orchestration, and the NVIDIA platform. You will help expert teams converge on integrations that improve RL framework quality and user value, then turn those decisions into measurable execution plans. The work includes benchmarking and reproducibility criteria, delivery across open-source frameworks and distributed runtimes, and close partnership with product management, research, DevRel, customer-facing teams, hardware, CUDA, networking, math libraries, compilers, and external open-source collaborators.

You will also build the team: recruiting and developing managers and senior ICs, creating an effective US/APAC operating model, reviewing capacity against commitments, and setting clear ownership and decision rights. You will coach engineers to contribute credibly in open-source ecosystems and carry NVIDIA's priorities through high-quality upstream work. Because the technical work crosses organizations by design, you will turn open technical and partner questions into concrete and measurable action, set delivery goals, and hold the quality bar. Success means validated, valuable work rather than work that merely lands, plus durable open-source improvements that make RL workloads run well on NVIDIA systems.

What We Need To See

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
10+ years of software engineering experience in distributed systems, AI frameworks, ML infrastructure, high-performance computing, or systems software, with 4+ years as an engineering manager for software teams
Strong technical background in distributed AI systems, including the ability to reason across training, inference, orchestration, and end-to-end performance, and challenge architecture and performance tradeoffs with senior engineers
Experience defining domain-level technical strategy, making build-vs-buy or upstream-vs-internal investment decisions, and creating multi-team execution plans
Ability to drive engineering work across organizational boundaries, influence without direct authority, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders and executives
Experience hiring and leading engineering teams, developing technical leaders or new managers, and creating staffing plans for constantly evolving technical domains
Experience establishing workflows, success criteria, metrics, or decision gates that improve engineering execution across teams
Background collaborating with open-source communities, research teams, external partners, or customer-facing teams

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Hands-on experience with RL post-training frameworks or algorithms such as RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, reward modeling, VeRL, Miles, Slime, SkyRL, OpenRLHF, NeMo-Aligner, or TorchTitan
Background with runtime and orchestration systems such as Ray, Monarch, Kubernetes, Slurm, or comparable actor- and task-based systems
Experience scaling workloads across thousands of GPUs or heterogeneous systems, including fault tolerance, elastic recovery, stragglers, resource contention, or benchmark reproducibility
Familiarity with NVIDIA platform components such as CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN, TensorRT-LLM, Transformer Engine, Nsight, NeMo, or Megatron-Core
Demonstrated ability to turn customer or partner needs into reusable upstream improvements rather than one-off support

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Hybrid - B2B, Enterprise Customers
jobs.description:
Come lead one of our product engineering teams! The team is responsible for our core user workflow and data orchestration platform. You'll own engineering execution end to end: roadmap sequencing with Product, project scoping, timeline accountability, and cross-functional progress communication. You'll serve as the connective tissue between Product and Engineering, ensuring the team builds the right things in the right order, at the pace the business demands. You'll drive engineering hiring end-to-end: headcount planning, JDs, interview loops, and closing. 
What you'll own:

-Team Building & Development: Hire, onboard, and develop a growing team of engineers. 
-Create a culture of high standards, ownership, and craft  
-Own the delivery system: project scoping, milestone planning, timeline accountability, and stakeholder communication. 
-Ensure the team ships on time, with consistency and quality, across the core product, integrations, and platform. 
-Partner with staff engineers and tech leads who own technical decisions and architecture. 
-Work closely with Product and Design to triage, prioritize, and sequence work. 
-Serve as the escalation point for customer-impacting engineering issues and coordinate resolution with CS and Product. 
-Incident & Production Management 
-Own the team's on-call posture, incident response process, and post-mortems. 
-Drive improvements that reduce recurrence and increase system reliability. 
What you need:

-10+ yrs in software engineering, including meaningful time as an IC and as an Engineering Manager. 
-5+ yrs as an individual contributor engineer, with a track record of shipping high-quality, high-complexity systems 
-5+ yrs managing engineering teams that have a track record of shipping high-quality, high-complexity systems
-Proven track record of growing and scaling an engineering organization, ideally from a small team to 20-30+ engineers. 
-Experience at an early-stage startup   
-You coach actively, give direct feedback, and create an environment where people grow fast and do their best work.  
-Building and shipping software for enterprise customers 
-Building with leading fintech APIs (Plaid, Stripe, etc). 
-Building APIs-as-a-product and/or B2B products. 
-Building data-intensive B2B platforms particularly systems that orchestrate, sync, or transform data across third-party integrations. 
-Experience founding or building something from scratch at a company, a product, or a meaningful side project. 
-Experience with AI prompting, models, and tools 
-Experience with our tech stack: Backend: Golang, Postgres, AWS, Messaging, Protobuf, gRPC, Redis, GitHub Actions, Containerization, Terraform Frontend: React, Node, Fastify, MUI, React Query, Vite, Storybook, Playwright

Office space in San Francisco and New York for in-person working

jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

Organizations are connecting industrial operations, modernizing control environments and integrating OT with enterprise technology. These changes create new cybersecurity, resilience and regulatory challenges across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors.

As an OT Cybersecurity Senior Manager in Technology Consulting, you will lead client engagements that assess, design and improve cybersecurity for Operational Technology and Industrial Control System environments. You will combine practical OT security knowledge with engagement leadership, client advisory, team development and business development. You will work across engineering, operations, cybersecurity and technology teams to help clients protect critical operations while supporting safety, availability and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead OT cybersecurity engagements, including maturity and risk assessments, architecture and configuration reviews, vulnerability assessments, security strategy, transformation roadmaps and implementation support.
Assess industrial environments that may include ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, SIS and IIoT technologies, industrial networks and supporting infrastructure.
Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.
Apply recognized OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82. Apply NIST CSF and sector-specific requirements when relevant to the client environment.
Lead client workshops and technical discussions with operational, engineering, cybersecurity and executive stakeholders. Translate technical findings into clear operational and business risk implications.
Manage engagement scope, workplans, resources, risks, quality, timelines and budgets. Keep client and EY stakeholders informed of progress and expected outcomes.
Lead, coach and develop engagement team members. Review deliverables and promote a collaborative, quality-focused and safety-aware working environment.
Build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities where EY can provide additional value.
Support business development through proposals, client presentations, solution shaping, methodology development, thought leadership and reusable assets.
Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

What We Look For

We are looking for professionals who combine OT and ICS technical credibility with practical consulting judgment. Successful candidates communicate clearly, collaborate across engineering, operations and cybersecurity teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes in complex industrial environments.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $204,800 to $425,500
Bay Area California offices – $213,300 to $443,200
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $170,600 to $390,000

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

Assess industrial environments that may include ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, SIS and IIoT technologies, industrial networks and supporting infrastructure.
Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.

Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

Assess industrial environments that may include ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, SIS and IIoT technologies, industrial networks and supporting infrastructure.
Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.

Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.

Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a Senior Manager in the R&I Independence Technology Team (ITT), you will play a pivotal role in maintaining regulatory compliance and managing risks for clients, providing advice and solutions. Within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will focus on identifying and mitigating potential risks that could impact an organization's operations and objectives. You will be responsible for developing business strategies to effectively manage and navigate risks in a rapidly changing business environment.

As a Senior Manager, you will leverage your skills and professional network to deliver quality results. You will motivate and coach others, coming together to solve complex problems. With increased autonomy, you will apply sound judgment, recognizing when to take action and when to escalate. Your ability to develop and sustain high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our firm.

In this role, you will craft and convey clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story. You will apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities, validate outcomes with stakeholders, and share alternative perspectives. Your leadership will guide the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging, and uncertain situations.

Responsibilities

Leading enterprise risk management initiatives to identify and mitigate potential risks impacting organizational operations and objectives
Developing business strategies to effectively manage risks in a rapidly changing environment
Applying analytical thinking to assess business risk and implement mitigation measures
Crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story to stakeholders
Directing teams through complex situations, demonstrating composure and strategic questioning
Validating outcomes with stakeholders and acting on feedback to improve risk management processes
Modeling and reinforcing professional and technical standards, including the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements
Initiating open and honest coaching conversations to develop high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams
Utilizing business process improvement techniques to enhance internal controls and regulatory compliance
Building relationships with business leaders to identify and address risk challenges effectively

What You Must Have

At least a High School Diploma or the equivalent degree
At least 6 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Finance, Risk Management/Insurance
Demonstrating advanced skills in Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
Utilizing Business Process Improvement techniques to drive results
Applying systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities
Excelling in contract negotiation and contractual risk mitigation
Leading teams through complexity with composure and strategic questioning
Developing and sustaining diverse and inclusive high-performing teams

jobs.title: Senior Data Science Manager, Developer Platform
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there's one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games.
Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is where the world's gamers hang out, and increasingly, it's the platform game developers build on. We're seeking a Senior Data Science Manager to lead Data Science for our Developer Platform: the SDKs, identity systems, and developer tools that connect games and their players to Discord.

What makes this role distinctive is the two-sided value equation at the heart of the platform. For game developers, we build tools that help studios grow player engagement and revenue, including data products that give them deeper insight into their players and communities. For players, we use signals from those same tools to make it easier to play and hang out with friends, deepen engagement across Discord, and deliver more relevant ads.

Your team's job is to make both sides of that exchange demonstrably valuable. That means proving the platform's worth to developers with rigorous evidence, and ensuring the signals it generates create outsized, responsible value for Discord users.

If helping make Discord an even better place to hang out with your friends and communities sounds like an exciting challenge - we'd love to chat with you!

What you'll be doing

Manage, mentor, and develop a mission-driven team of Data Scientists embedded across the Developer Platform's core areas: identity, signals, and developer tools.
Own the vision and roadmap for data-driven decision-making across the Developer Platform org, and shape company strategy on how the platform creates value for both developers and Discord.
Strengthen the developer side of the value equation by shaping developer-facing data products, including metric definitions, benchmarking methodologies, and insight quality.
Strengthen the Discord side of the value equation by partnering with Ads, Engagement, and Growth to identify, validate, and productize platform-derived signals, and by measuring their incremental value through experimentation.
Drive platform adoption by partnering with Product, Engineering, and Business Development to measure integration health, forecast growth, and surface insights that help the org land and deepen integrations with the world's largest game developers.
Serve as a trusted analytical partner to top game developers, designing joint studies with partner data science teams to uncover business value from the developer tech stack.
Partner with Data Engineering, Product, and Legal on data governance: ensure platform signals are documented, discoverable, and governed well across Discord.
Set clear priorities and nimble operating models, and build a team known for rigorous methods and decision-ready work. Partner with other Data leaders to shape the direction and culture of Discord's Data organization..

What you should have

8+ years of experience in applied data science and advanced analytics, ideally including both consumer product and B2B or platform contexts.
3+ years managing and developing teams of Data Scientists, with a track record of growing ICs and raising the team's technical bar.
Strong expertise in experimentation and causal inference, including quasi-experimental methods (propensity matching, synthetic controls, diff-in-diff) for settings where randomized experiments aren't feasible.
Experience designing novel, interpretable metrics for a new or fast-evolving product area, and building the measurement systems around them.
Proficiency in SQL and at least one data programming language (Python or R).
Clear communication and influence. You can translate complex technical work into crisp narratives for executives, engineers, and external partners, and use data to shape strategy and roadmaps alongside Product and Engineering leadership.

Bonus points

Experience with gaming, game platforms, or developer-facing (B2B2C) products, especially working directly with external partners' data or analytics teams.
Experience building or shaping customer-facing data products such as analytics dashboards, benchmarking tools, or measurement offerings.
Familiarity with advertising signal ecosystems (event pipelines, identity resolution, targeting and measurement, lookalike modeling) and with ML applications for signal enrichment, forecasting, or personalization.
Experience with cloud data platforms like BigQuery, very large datasets, and modern BI tools (e.g., Hex, Mode, Looker, Tableau).
Understanding of data governance, privacy, and responsible data use, particularly for signals shared across product and revenue systems.
Interest in Discord, gaming, and the communities we serve.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $342,000 to $380,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

jobs.description:
Description

**The Opportunity**

95% of enterprise technology pilots deliver zero measurable P&L impact. The technology works — the gap is in the last mile: getting production systems running inside complex enterprises where legacy infrastructure, regulated data, and organizational complexity collide. AWS is making a billion-dollar investment in Forward Deployed Engineering ("FDE") to close that gap, and we're hiring product leaders who will define what we build and why.

This is a greenfield role. You'll build a product management practice, shape an entirely new category at AWS, and establish the engagement model that delivers delightful outcomes enabling customers to transform themselves.

**The Role**

As the Director of Product Management — Forward Deployed Engineering will lead product management for FDE, building and leading the PM team that owns the end-to-end product lifecycle from customer engagement through production delivery through optimization and self-sufficiency. Your product managers embed directly inside enterprise customers — defining outcomes, writing specs, working hand-in-hand with engineering to ship production systems — and every engagement feeds back into AWS services and an underlying platform that makes the next one faster.

This is not a traditional AWS Product Management role. FDE product managers are field-facing: they live inside delivery, sit with customers, and turn engagement learnings into compounding platform value. You are the "CEO of the customer problem" — responsible for the *why* and *what*, while engineering owns the *how*.

Key job responsibilities

### Product Leadership

You own the customer outcomes. Your teams operate inside customer environments under real constraints and ambitious timelines — regulated data, brownfield infrastructure, multi-stakeholder governance. You lead the customer engagement strategy from the product side: define what a great pod PM does, allocate PM talent across engagements, ensure pods are solving the right problems, and hold executive customer relationships at the CIO/CTO level built on trust earned through delivered outcomes.

### Product & Platform Influence

You see what breaks across deployments and turn that into product direction. You influence AWS service roadmap from a position of earned authority because you've lived the deployment pain firsthand, and identify when custom pod work should graduate into platform primitives or native service capabilities.

You shape the FDE engagement model: how we scope, what we deliver, what we price, what we leave behind.

### Industry Practice & Productization

You build the domain expertise that compounds. Your teams develop industry-specific accelerators, reference architectures, and blueprints that generate pipeline for the next customer in your vertical. You define the use cases that feed qualification, pricing, and pod composition. You measure what matters: asset reuse rate, time-to-value, engagement velocity

### Go-to-Market Partnership

You partner with sales, specialists, and marketing to define pricing, packaging, and positioning. You own the commercial model for FDE engagements — how we price outcomes, what the customer buys, and how we demonstrate ROI. You build pipeline through customer stories, reference architectures

Basic Qualifications

BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field
15+ years in product management, with significant experience in enterprise environments
Track record building and leading product management teams through complex enterprise applications with direct customer and business impact
Technical depth — agentic systems, AI/ML, business workflow automation, enterprise integration — ability to engage at the architecture level and roll up sleeves when the hardest problems demand it
Experience with pricing, packaging, and go-to-market — having partnered with sales, marketing, and GTM teams to define commercial models and build pipeline
Executive presence with C-suite customers, earned through outcomes — can run a room with a VP/CTO and translate business problems into product requirements in real time

Founder mentality — has built a team, product, or practice from scratch and scaled it
Experience delivering production systems inside large enterprise customer environments: regulated data, legacy infrastructure, organizational complexity, multi-party governance
Has built industry-specific solutions or vertical practices at scale — creating reusable assets that became a competitive moat
Builder-leader who ships alongside the team, is energized by customer problems, and operates where the customer sees your results in real-time

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - RL Post-Training Frameworks
jobs.description:
Can you bring together globally distributed teams and the systems they build into a production-quality reinforcement learning ecosystem for researchers and model builders? Reinforcement learning post-training is where modern AI systems learn to reason, use tools, follow detailed instructions, and act as agents. Making that capability work at scale creates one of the most demanding systems problems in AI: a single RL run ties together inference, rollout, reward and critic evaluation, and training. At frontier scale, these loops have to run reliably across GPUs, CPUs, networking, storage, and open-source runtimes. You will lead the work to build, extend, and harden the rapidly evolving pieces to compose cleanly and scale with the most ambitious RL projects on NVIDIA's platforms.

To meet that challenge, NVIDIA is building an RL Frameworks engineering team for the open-source tools and infrastructure that researchers, model builders, and external partners depend on. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to set strategy, build the team, and convert emerging technical, customer, and partner signals into clear engineering priorities. The role spans RL frameworks such as VeRL, Miles, Slime, SkyRL, TorchTitan, and related post-training stacks, along with the systems those stacks build on and compose with: Megatron-Core, Ray, Monarch, NIXL, SGLang, Kubernetes, and NVIDIA platform libraries. Come build the ecosystem that the next generation of AI will rely on!

What You Will Be Doing

You will own NVIDIA's RL post-training frameworks strategy: where we invest directly, where we partner upstream, and how we prioritize based on customer impact, ecosystem leverage, technical feasibility, and opportunity cost. This is senior technical leadership work: using systems depth to evaluate architecture and performance claims across training, inference, rollout, orchestration, and the NVIDIA platform. You will help expert teams converge on integrations that improve RL framework quality and user value, then turn those decisions into measurable execution plans. The work includes benchmarking and reproducibility criteria, delivery across open-source frameworks and distributed runtimes, and close partnership with product management, research, DevRel, customer-facing teams, hardware, CUDA, networking, math libraries, compilers, and external open-source collaborators.

You will also build the team: recruiting and developing managers and senior ICs, creating an effective US/APAC operating model, reviewing capacity against commitments, and setting clear ownership and decision rights. You will coach engineers to contribute credibly in open-source ecosystems and carry NVIDIA's priorities through high-quality upstream work. Because the technical work crosses organizations by design, you will turn open technical and partner questions into concrete and measurable action, set delivery goals, and hold the quality bar. Success means validated, valuable work rather than work that merely lands, plus durable open-source improvements that make RL workloads run well on NVIDIA systems.

What We Need To See

MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
10+ years of software engineering experience in distributed systems, AI frameworks, ML infrastructure, high-performance computing, or systems software, with 4+ years as an engineering manager for software teams
Strong technical background in distributed AI systems, including the ability to reason across training, inference, orchestration, and end-to-end performance, and challenge architecture and performance tradeoffs with senior engineers
Experience defining domain-level technical strategy, making build-vs-buy or upstream-vs-internal investment decisions, and creating multi-team execution plans
Ability to drive engineering work across organizational boundaries, influence without direct authority, and communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders and executives
Experience hiring and leading engineering teams, developing technical leaders or new managers, and creating staffing plans for constantly evolving technical domains
Experience establishing workflows, success criteria, metrics, or decision gates that improve engineering execution across teams
Background collaborating with open-source communities, research teams, external partners, or customer-facing teams

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Hands-on experience with RL post-training frameworks or algorithms such as RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, reward modeling, VeRL, Miles, Slime, SkyRL, OpenRLHF, NeMo-Aligner, or TorchTitan
Background with runtime and orchestration systems such as Ray, Monarch, Kubernetes, Slurm, or comparable actor- and task-based systems
Experience scaling workloads across thousands of GPUs or heterogeneous systems, including fault tolerance, elastic recovery, stragglers, resource contention, or benchmark reproducibility
Familiarity with NVIDIA platform components such as CUDA, NCCL, cuDNN, TensorRT-LLM, Transformer Engine, Nsight, NeMo, or Megatron-Core
Demonstrated ability to turn customer or partner needs into reusable upstream improvements rather than one-off support

Senior Manager, Security Engineering

Business Technology, Security

REPORTING AREA

Security - CISO

FUNCTION

Business Technology

TEAM MODEL

United States and India

LEADERSHIP SCOPE

Application/Product Security; Infrastructure/Cloud Security; Vulnerability Management

ROLE TYPE

Leader with technical depth

ENVIRONMENT

AI-first, cloud-native SaaS

Role Purpose

Lead the security engineering organization that protects 6sense's AI-enabled, cloud-native SaaS platform. This leader owns Vulnerability Operations, Infrastructure Security, and Application/Product Security, and is accountable for building scalable security capabilities that enable rapid product delivery without compromising customer trust, resilience, or compliance. The role leads a distributed team across the United States and India and combines strategic leadership with credible technical judgment.

Leadership Mandate

Build one integrated security engineering operating model across the three teams, with clear ownership, service expectations, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Data, AI/ML, Security Operations, Privacy, GRC, and Enterprise Technology leaders to embed security into planning and delivery.
Create an inclusive, high-accountability culture across time zones using clear decisions, durable documentation, effective handoffs, and intentional overlap for critical work.
Balance hands-on technical engagement with people leadership, program ownership, stakeholder influence, and executive-level risk communication.

Core Responsibilities

Organization and People Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop managers and engineers across the United States and India. Establish role clarity, career paths, succession coverage, and consistent performance expectations.
Create an operating cadence that supports asynchronous execution, reliable cross-region handoffs, rapid escalation, and shared accountability.
Build workforce and capacity plans aligned to product growth, AI investment, risk, and business priorities.
Foster a culture of constructive challenge, disagree and commit, continuous learning, quality, and automation-first improvement.
AI and Product Security
Own the security strategy for AI-enabled product capabilities from design through production, including threat modeling, architecture review, secure development standards, testing, monitoring, and release readiness.
Address AI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool or agent access, sensitive-data exposure, model and data pipeline integrity, excessive agency, abuse, and third-party model or service dependencies.
Partner with AI/ML, Product, and Engineering teams to define secure patterns for models, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, application programming interfaces, data access, and human approval controls.
Advance product security practices including secure software development lifecycle controls, code and design review, application security testing, penetration testing, security champions, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty.
Vulnerability Operations
Own end-to-end vulnerability discovery, prioritization, remediation governance, exception management, and validation across applications, cloud infrastructure, containers, endpoints, operating systems, and third-party components.
Move beyond severity-only prioritization by incorporating exploitability, internet exposure, asset criticality, data sensitivity, available compensating controls, and active threat intelligence.
Improve remediation speed and predictability through automation, clear service-level objectives, transparent ownership, and decision-ready reporting.
Establish effective coverage for software supply chain risk, including open-source dependencies, build systems, artifacts, secrets, and continuous integration and delivery pipelines.
Infrastructure and Cloud Security
Own preventive and detective security guardrails for the AWS environment, infrastructure as code, containers, identity and access, network boundaries, workloads, secrets, logging, and data services.
Partner with Infrastructure and Platform Engineering to make secure cloud patterns easy to adopt and to reduce reliance on manual review.
Drive least privilege, secure administrative access, workload identity, segmentation, configuration assurance, and continuous cloud risk reduction.
Ensure architecture and change reviews focus on material risk while preserving engineering velocity.
Strategy, Governance, and Business Partnership
Translate business strategy, product roadmaps, AI priorities, threat trends, customer commitments, and audit requirements into a multi-quarter security engineering roadmap.
Define quarterly objectives and key results, key performance indicators, and key risk indicators that show coverage, outcomes, trends, and remaining exposure.
Communicate risk and tradeoffs clearly to technical leaders and executives. Escalate material risks with practical options, owners, and recommended decisions.
Maintain policies, standards, control evidence, inventories, and operating procedures that support SOC 2, ISO 27001, privacy, customer assurance, and other applicable obligations.
Evaluate and rationalize security tools and services based on measurable risk reduction, engineer experience, coverage, integration, and total cost.

Success Measures

Success will be measured by outcomes and sustained operating health, not activity volume alone:

Risk reduction

Material vulnerabilities and security design risks are identified early, prioritized consistently, and remediated or formally accepted within defined objectives.

Coverage

Security controls and testing provide measurable coverage across product code, AI features, cloud infrastructure, containers, identities, dependencies, and critical data paths.

Engineering velocity

Approved secure patterns, automation, and self-service controls reduce security friction and late-stage rework.

AI security readiness

AI features have repeatable security requirements, threat models, tests, release criteria, monitoring, and documented residual risk.

Operational maturity

The three teams operate with clear ownership, reliable cross-region handoffs, actionable metrics, current documentation, and effective escalation.

People and leadership

The organization demonstrates strong engagement, skill growth, succession depth, retention, and accountable delivery across locations.

Stakeholder trust

Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and executive partners receive timely, clear, decision-ready security guidance and reporting.

Required Experience And Capabilities

8+ years in information security, including significant experience in product or application security, cloud security, vulnerability management, or security engineering.
3+ years leading security engineering teams, including experience managing distributed or cross-region teams. Experience leading managers is preferred.
Demonstrated ability to build and mature security programs in a cloud-native SaaS environment, preferably on AWS.

Strong executive and technical communication skills, including the ability to explain complex risk in plain language and influence without relying on authority.

Application and product security: threat modeling, architecture review, static and dynamic testing, code review, penetration testing, security champions, application programming interface security, and bug bounty or coordinated disclosure.
Cloud and infrastructure security: AWS, cloud security posture management, cloud-native application protection, identity and access management, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, secrets, operating system hardening, and logging.

AI security: model and data access, prompt injection, agent and tool permissions, retrieval security, output handling, data leakage prevention, red teaming, abuse monitoring, and third-party AI service risk.

Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant certification such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, or an advanced cloud security certification.
Experience in a high-growth business-to-business SaaS company and in customer-facing security assurance.

Leads with clarity, trust, accountability, and sound judgment.
Develops people and creates space for strong technical leaders to lead.
Prioritizes based on business impact and risk, not noise or tool output.
Communicates early, directly, and in plain language.
Uses data to guide decisions while recognizing where judgment is required.
Challenges constructively, commits to decisions, and follows through.
Stays current on modern threats affecting cloud-native SaaS and AI-enabled products.

Organizations are connecting industrial operations, modernizing control environments and integrating OT with enterprise technology. These changes create new cybersecurity, resilience and regulatory challenges across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors.

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.

Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.

Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

This is a senior level Engineering position with emphasis on technical authority for product architecture, technology roadmap development, standards, and cross-functional technical decision-making. Responsibilities include defining and driving PSG's long-term technology vision, architecture strategy, and innovation roadmap across hardware, software, firmware, system integration, and emerging technologies and work with Operations on various product engineering tasks. Some amount of hands-on development acitivity such as design of high speed interfaces, PCB layout, simulations, component selection and support to manufacturing /customer support on various acitivites is expected. This is a product development position requiring thorough background in developing high end systems including high speed simulation, layout guidence, RF and electrical measurements, and working with Mech Engr for enclosure design and associated sub assemblies. This leader partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Executive Leadership to ensure that technology investments align with business objectives while enabling scalable product platforms, accelerated innovation, and sustainable competitive differentiation.

Develop and maintain PSG's 3-5 year technology roadmap. Identify emerging technologies, market trends, and potential disruptions. Evaluate build, buy, and partner opportunities. Drive innovation initiatives aligned with strategic business objectives. Guide technology investment decisions and portfolio prioritization including custom silicon development and lifecycle-transition management.
Conduct and Participate in various high speed circuit simulation and circuit design reviews and be responsible for system design and functionality.
Define architectural principles across hardware, firmware, and system platforms. Develop, lead and own system architecture for major product initiatives. Ensure technology reuse and common platform strategies across product families. Establish architecture, governance, processes and technical standards. Balance innovation with maintainability and product lifecycle requirements.
Partner with Product Management to translate market requirements into technology roadmaps. Ensure product development plans align with long-term architectural direction. Drive platform strategies that enable faster product development and lower R&D costs. Evaluate technology tradeoffs related to performance, cost, risk, and schedule.
Serve as senior advisor to engineering leaders. Foster a culture of technical excellence and engineering rigor. Lead resolution of critical technical challenges across programs.
Work closely with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams. Support customer engagements involving strategic technical discussions. Participate in executive reviews, strategic planning, and M&A technical evaluations when required. Represent PSG in industry forums, standards bodies, and key customer interactions. Maintain ownership of standards documents and restricted technical repositories.
Monitor industry trends in technologies below. Drive technology incubation projects. Identify opportunities for platform differentiation.
High-speed interconnects such as USB/USB4
PCIe Gen6/Gen7 and beyond
Ethernet, UALink, and networking
AI infrastructure
Storage technologies
Test and measurement platforms

BS/MS in EE or CE (MS or PhD preferred)
15+ years of engineering leadership experience.
Minimum of 10 years of system/board level design exp designing and developing and leading high end, high speed complex platforms including latest bus topologies, CPU, and memory interfaces.
Minimum of 5 years of exp managing cross platform engineering teams.
Excellent knowledge of high speed (20Gbps or higher) design methodologies and simulation, including latest bus technologies such as PCIe, USB, SAS/SATA, Video and/or Ethernet.
Excellent knowledge of FPGA and/or chip design methodologies, RF/Microwave design techniques and implementation.
Excellent knowledge in high speed circuit design, implementation and measurements.
Demonstrated success delivering hardware and software products.
Experience developing multi-year technology roadmaps.
Strong executive communication skills. Experience in developing and implementing development processes.
Ability to influence across global engineering organizations..
Good knowlwdge of manufacturing processes and taking a product from development into manufacturing.
Working knowledge of various EMC/EMI control methods and implementation at PCB/component level.
Working experience with various schematic entry tools and test/measurement equipment including high-speed, real-time oscilloscopes, network/spectrum analyzers, and logic analyzers.
Strong system development experience with wholistic approach.
Team player. Be able to share knowledge, learn from others, and support other groups within an organization.

jobs.title: Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Forequence is seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial technical leader to join as Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer. This is a founder partnership with meaningful ownership, not a conventional salaried executive role or outsourced development position.

The Opportunity

Unlike many early-stage opportunities, you will not be starting with only an idea. Forequence already has:

A clearly defined enterprise problem
A developed product vision
Proprietary indices, scoring methodologies, and assessment logic
A growing body of original global research
An early MVP
Ongoing enterprise pilot conversations
Leading research, strategy, positioning, commercial development, and go-to-market
The foundation for a differentiated and defensible category in organizational intelligence

About Forequence

Forequence is an enterprise intelligence platform that helps organizations detect human strain before it becomes burnout, attrition, disengagement, or execution failure. Organizations have become highly sophisticated at measuring productivity, performance, revenue, and output. They remain far less capable of understanding the human capacity sustaining those outcomes. Most workforce platforms tell companies what has already happened. Forequence is being built to help organizations see what is developing beneath the surface, understand where human capacity is under pressure, identify the conditions driving that pressure, and intervene before it becomes an expensive organizational failure. Through proprietary organizational indices, behavioral signals, AI-supported analysis, and enterprise intelligence, Forequence helps leaders make better decisions about people, performance, capacity, and risk.

Meaningful Founder Ownership

You will join as a genuine co-founder with meaningful equity and long-term participation in the value you help create. This is not an advisory title, symbolic ownership, or an employee role disguised as a founder opportunity. The right person will help shape the company's technology, product, strategy, team, fundraising, and future. Equity, vesting, responsibilities, decision rights, intellectual property, and founder expectations will be discussed transparently and formalized properly.

Build From a Stronger Starting Point

You will not be responsible for inventing the problem, researching the market from scratch, creating the brand, defining the initial methodology, and building the technology alone. Forequence already has a substantial body of developed intellectual property, research, scoring logic, product thinking, market positioning, and commercial direction. You will bring the technical depth required to transform those assets into a scalable enterprise platform.

Significant Product Influence

The platform is early enough for you to make foundational decisions. You will have meaningful authority over:

Product architecture
Technical strategy
AI and data infrastructure
Enterprise security and privacy
Engineering standards
Product development priorities
Technical hiring
Platform integrations
Scalability and defensibility
The long-term technology roadmap

A Timely Market Opportunity

Artificial intelligence is accelerating the speed, complexity, and intensity of work. As organizations invest more heavily in automation, productivity, and performance technologies, they will also need better intelligence about the people operating alongside those systems. The central question is no longer only whether companies can increase output. It is whether they can understand the human capacity required to sustain that output. Forequence is positioned at the intersection of enterprise AI, workforce intelligence, organizational performance, people analytics, and human sustainability.

Build the Team and Culture From the Beginning

You will have the opportunity to recruit the early engineering and data team, establish the technical culture, and define how the company builds. You will not inherit a dysfunctional engineering organization, outdated infrastructure, or a deeply embedded development process. The early technical standards will be yours to help create.

The Partnership

As Co-Founder And CTO, You Will Work Directly With The Founder To Build Forequence Into a Scalable Enterprise Company. The Partnership Will Include

Meaningful co-founder equity
Shared responsibility for company direction
Direct influence over major product and business decisions
A clear division of ownership based on complementary strengths
Transparent founder agreements and vesting
Participation in fundraising and investor conversations
The opportunity to build and lead the technical organization
Long-term involvement in the commercial value created by the platform

What You Will Own

Technology — Define the architecture, engineering roadmap, infrastructure, development standards, and technical direction of Forequence.
Product Development — Translate proprietary research, indices, assessment logic, and enterprise requirements into a functional, intuitive, and commercially viable platform.
AI and Data — Develop the systems required to identify patterns, surface insights, support organizational decision-making, and responsibly incorporate AI into the product.
Security Readiness — Establish the security, privacy, governance, reliability, and technical controls required to serve enterprise customers.
Validation — Work directly with prospective customers and pilot organizations to refine use cases, test assumptions, prioritize development, and improve the product.
Technical Team — Recruit, lead, and develop the early engineering, data, and technical product team.
Strategy — Contribute to product positioning, pricing, commercial strategy, partnerships, fundraising, and the long-term development of the company.
Capital — Participate in technical due diligence, investor conversations, fundraising strategy, and the articulation of Forequence's technological advantage.

Co-Founder Profile

About

You do not need to meet every requirement. We care more about depth, judgment, learning ability, founder mentality, and alignment than a perfect résumé. You may be a strong fit if you have:

Experience building and shipping complex software products
Worked as a technical founder, CTO, senior engineer, architect, or engineering leader
Strong hands-on technical capability
Experience building B2B SaaS, AI, analytics, data, HR technology, or enterprise platforms
A solid understanding of modern cloud infrastructure, APIs, databases, application architecture, and security
The ability to translate ambiguous problems into practical technical systems
Strong product judgment
Experience working directly with customers or enterprise stakeholders
The ability to recruit and lead technical talent
An understanding of startup constraints and disciplined prioritization
High standards, intellectual honesty, and low ego
The willingness to make a serious long-term commitment to building Forequence

Particularly Relevant Experience

Experience In Any Of The Following Would Be Valuable

Enterprise SaaS
Applied AI or machine learning
Data analytics platforms
People analytics
HR technology
Workforce intelligence
Organizational network analysis
Predictive or risk intelligence
Data visualization
Privacy-sensitive technology
SOC 2 readiness
GDPR or PIPEDA compliance
Enterprise integrations
Early-stage fundraising
Scaling engineering teams

A Note

We are looking for someone who can distinguish between what is technologically impressive and what is commercially necessary.

focused on SRE, observability, reliability, and cloud platform engineering
. This leader will be responsible for developing the team, driving technical strategy, improving platform reliability and performance, and partnering with architecture and engineering leadership in a highly regulated financial-services environment.
