hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.
Diversity is not just the right thing to do; it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

Permanent, Director of Engineering, Combination Products

Summary

Our client, a small, growing medical device organization, has engaged GForce Life Sciences to provide a Director of Engineering. This role combines people leadership, technical authority, client engagement, and operational ownership. The ideal candidate has deep experience developing drug-device combination products and can lead teams working across autoinjectors, pen injectors, prefilled syringes, on-body/wearable injectors, infusion systems, and related delivery platforms.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set technical direction, develop engineers, strengthen laboratory execution, and serve as a credible technical partner to clients from early development through verification, validation, investigation, and design-history-file execution.

Job Duties

Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of approximately 12–15 engineers; build technical depth through coaching, feedback, mentoring, and clear performance expectations.
Provide technical leadership and final engineering review for protocols, reports, investigations, deviations, test methods, design inputs, risk documentation, and other critical technical deliverables.
Lead complex medical-device and combination-product programs, including test-method development and validation, design-input refinement, design verification and validation, failure investigation, and design-history-file support.
Drive engineering excellence across the laboratory by improving technical capability, equipment readiness, documentation quality, throughput, right-first-time execution, and use of sound engineering and statistical methods.
Partner with Quality and Operations to ensure equipment qualification, calibration, maintenance, laboratory readiness, and compliant execution are effectively planned and sustained.
Serve as a senior technical interface with clients: translate ambiguous technical problems into practical development strategies, communicate risk and recommendations clearly, and guide teams toward sound technical decisions.
Support growth of companies services by contributing to proposals, technical scoping, new-service development, client relationships, and thought leadership.
Apply critical thinking, risk-based decision making, root-cause analysis, and data-driven problem solving to resolve technical issues and continuously improve engineering processes.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a closely related technical discipline; advanced degree is a plus.
Approximately 15+ years of progressive medical-device / product-development experience, with substantial experience in drug-device combination products and injection systems.
Proven leadership of engineering teams, including direct people management, technical coaching, resource prioritization, and performance accountability.
Demonstrated success leading complex development, testing, verification/validation, or investigation programs in regulated environments.
Strong working knowledge of design controls, DHF expectations, risk management, statistics, root-cause analysis, and applicable device / combination-product standards.
Broad technical understanding of device design, materials, manufacturing processes, test equipment, laboratory methods, and failure mechanisms.
Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, executives, Quality, Commercial teams, external partners, and clients.
Recognized technical depth in one or more relevant areas and the judgment to challenge assumptions and guide sound engineering decisions.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The University at Buffalo
(UB) invites nominations and applications for the position of Assistant Vice President of Infrastructure (AVP). Reporting to the Vice President and Chief Information Officer, the AVP will be responsible for leading the Enterprise Infrastructure Services and Network and Communication Services units across UB's three campuses.

University at Buffalo

Impactful research
,scholarly distinction, transformative student experiences, and far-reaching service to local, state, national, and international communities define UB's mission as one of the nation's leading public research universities. UB was founded in 1846 as a private medical college located in downtown Buffalo and joined the SUNY network in 1962. SUNY is the largest state university system in the United States, and UB is a flagship campus and the largest and most comprehensive public research university within the system. In 1989, UB was among the first public universities in the Northeast to be admitted into the AAU. Over the years, UB's scope and mission have expanded significantly as it has grown into a world-renowned research university that is the thriving heart of the regional community, a national leader in public higher education, and a global hub for excellence in research and education.

UB enrolls more than 32,000 students (approximately two-thirds undergraduate and one-third graduate and professional students) and offers more than 500 degree programs at the baccalaureate, master's, professional, and doctoral levels acrossits 12 decanal units
. UB has a distinguished faculty of over 1,500 full-time members. UB is currently undertaking its largest faculty­ hiring initiative in recent history, Advancing Top 25: UB Faculty Hiring
, with plans to recruit upward of 200 full-time faculty over the next two years.

UB is home to more than 120 research centers and institutes; its current annual research expenditures, including those in affiliated institutions, exceed $425 million. UB's academic programs and facilities are located on three distinct campuses in the Buffalo metropolitan area. UB's North Campus, located in the suburb of Amherst, is the university's main undergraduate campus and home to the university's primary athletics and cultural facilities. Three miles to the south, on the northern edge of the City of Buffalo, is the university's historic South Campus, home to many of the university's professional schools. The focal point of UB's third, downtown campus center is the Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus, on which UB's state-of-the-art Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences is in proximity to the university's health and life science partners. UB also competes in the prestigious Mid-American Conference and at the highest level of National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) competition, the FBS Division I level.

With an annual operating revenue of $850 million, UB and its affiliated entities generate an estimated economic impact of $2.1 billion annually in New York State. The university's total workforce of over 9,000 full-time equivalent employees makes it one of the region's largest employers. UB is also a leader and an active partner with the more than 20 public and private colleges and universities in the Buffalo-Niagara region.

The Position

The Assistant Vice President for Infrastructure (AVP)
is a dynamic and visionary leader that is a strategic partner and advisor to the Vice President and Chief Information Officer (VPCIO)
. This is a VPCIO Cabinet Leadership
position that plays a pivotal role in shaping and growing the UB Information Technology (UBIT)
organization to align with and advance the university's goals. As a member of the VPCIO Cabinet, the AVP will ensure that UBIT’s people, processes, and technology are equipped to support the university's mission. The AVP directs special projects and strategic priorities as assigned by the VPCIO, spanning institutional planning, cross-divisional partnerships, and IT governance. This position serves as a senior thought leader in the university’s digital transformation efforts, proactively contributing towards the future direction of technology at the university.

The AVP for Infrastructure
provides strategic leadership for the Enterprise Infrastructure Services (EIS
) and Network and Communication Services (NCS)
units, ensuring UB’s network, cloud, data center, and core computer environments remain secure, reliable, and scalable, while advancing technologies, systems, and processes to meet UB’s goals. Working closely with campus partners and IT leadership, the AVP drives coordinated service delivery, continuous improvement, and infrastructure innovation that supports the university’s academic, research, and administrative needs.

This is a newly created role, and the AVP
will have the opportunity to shape how these two units – each with its own history, culture, and operating rhythm – come together as a single, unified infrastructure organization. The successful candidate will build trust across both teams while also thinking beyond day-to-day operations: reassessing UB’s data center footprint, advancing a deliberate cloud and colocation strategy, and positioning the university’s infrastructure to support an ambitious research and AI agenda. The AVP
will need to balance the discipline required to keep mission-critical systems running with the vision to challenge long-standing practices and move UBIT’s infrastructure into closer alignment with where the university is headed.

Key Responsibilities

Departmental Leadership

Provide strategic direction and oversight to the EIS and NCS units, which includes establishing and advancing a cohesive portfolio strategy aligned with the university’s mission and goals and VPCIO priorities, ensuring coordination across infrastructure and communication systems, emerging technologies, and customer-facing services
This role carries a substantive policymaking function. By directing the planning, design, and operation of the university’s data networks, telecommunications, and enterprise infrastructure systems, the AVP leads the establishment and enforcement of the technical and operational policies that guide campus wide technology use, reliability, security, and compliance. The position’s regular engagement with senior academic and administrative leadership ensures that infrastructure standards and related policies align with institutional priorities.
Lead long-range and annual planning, including workforce and succession planning, budget oversight, and investment prioritization to ensure sustainable operations and future-ready capabilities
Assess the current structure, staffing levels, and operations of EIS and NCS, and lead the organizational changes needed to address staffing gaps, evolving service demands, and succession needs, given the significant portion of both units’ workforce eligible for retirement in the coming years
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement by promoting professional development, mentoring leaders, and enabling teams to deliver high-quality, secure, and customer-centered IT solutions

Drive Strategic Alignment

Ensure that IT initiatives are closely aligned with the university’s strategic goals and mission
Work with university leadership to shape, prioritize, and execute projects that support academic, administrative, and research objectives, while balancing divisional advocacy with institutional priorities and shared enterprise outcomes

Foster Synergies

Promote collaboration and synergy among UBIT departments including but not limited to Innovation, Enterprise Application Services, IT Customer Experience, and Research IT
Leverage strengths and expertise to create a cohesive, efficient IT environment that enhances performance and innovation

Innovate and Transform

Champion innovation and transformation and identify opportunities for technological advancements, process improvements, and new initiatives that move the university forward
Lead the evaluation and evolution of UB’s data center strategy, including assessment of colocation options and consolidation of aging, decentralized data center and server infrastructure across campus
Advance UB’s cloud adoption strategy, building on early planning efforts to shift appropriate administrative and enterprise systems to cloud and hybrid-cloud environments
Partner with UBIT’s Innovation and Research IT units, and academic and research partners to ensure infrastructure supports the university’s growing AI and research computing needs
Champion improvements in customer service and responsiveness across EIS and NCS, working to change perceptions of infrastructure as a barrier to progress and building stronger partnerships with academic and administrative units

Build and Strengthen UBIT

In partnership with other AVPs and senior leaders within UBIT, build and strengthen the VPCIO organization in operating as an integrated leadership team
Develop and implement strategies to enhance the capabilities and effectiveness of UBIT while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and ensuring that the VPCIO is well-positioned to support the university's evolving needs

Buffalo Niagara

As a world-renowned research university, UB's intellectual capital and innovation are playing a vital role in Buffalo's resurgence as a thriving city that is a magnet for talented professionals, artists, entrepreneurs, and innovators who recognize the tremendous energy and momentum gathering here. Home to one of the nation's fastest growing populations of college graduates, the Buffalo­Niagara region, with 1.2 million residents, is the state's second largest major metropolitan area, exceeded only by New York City. The region includes a diverse blend of communities, each with its own distinct personality, yet commonly characterized by a distinctly neighborly way of life, an unpretentious nature and spirited loyalty among residents. Buffalo's own strong sense of community, easy lifestyle, and affordability regularly place it in top ten lists from a variety of national publications for its overall quality of life.

Rich in natural resources and beauty, the Buffalo-Niagara area is a four-season region that offers the best for seasonal sports enthusiasts. University at Buffalo fans enjoy a full complement of NCAA division I sports with the UB Bulls, as well as the NFL's Buffalo Bills, the NH L's Buffalo Sabres, Triple­A baseball's Buffalo Bisons, and the National Lacrosse League's Buffalo Bandits.

Less than a two-hour drive from Buffalo across the United States-Canada border is Toronto, the cultural, entertainment, and financial capital of Canada. Buffalo is also ideally located for easy access to many of America's major cities. The Buffalo-Niagara International Airport offers direct flights to more than 20 cities, including New York, Boston, Philadelphia, Chicago, and Washington, DC, all only an hour's flight away.

UB has played a central role in the creation of a strong, sustainable knowledge economy and thriving entrepreneurial culture that are driving Buffalo's revitalization. Exemplified and driven by the centrally located Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus, UB's Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences, Buffalo is experiencing a period of tremendous progress and momentum as well as unprecedented regional investments in the industries of the future and in the assets that ensure a satisfying quality of life for all its citizens.

Land Acknowledgment

Further, we responsibly acknowledge the continuing impact of settler colonialism on the Haudenosaunee and their territories.

Why you’ll love this role

Join a team of ML Engineers and Applied Scientists shaping how millions of buyers and sellers experience StockX. From finding the right product to detecting counterfeits, you’ll tackle new challenges across our Live, Listings, and Core businesses—and turn advances in AI/ML into real marketplace impact.

Own the AI/ML engineering strategy and roadmap, connecting technical investments to customer needs and business priorities.
Build and develop a high-performing team of ML engineers and applied scientists, growing technical leaders and managers as the organization scales.
Lead delivery across search, recommendations, pricing, forecasting, fraud detection, and counterfeit detection.
Set technical direction, guide architecture and model decisions, and choose the right approach—from classical ML to generative AI.
Drive rigorous experimentation and A/B testing to measure impact and focus resources on what works.
Scale ML platforms and MLOps practices that help teams ship quickly, reliably, and cost-effectively.
Own hiring, performance, resource planning, and investment tradeoffs; align senior stakeholders on priorities and results.

About you

10+ years of relevant, hands-on experience in ML engineering or applied science, with a track record of building and operating production ML systems.

5+ years of engineering leadership experience, including hiring, developing talent, and leading multiple complex workstreams.
Experience owning an AI/ML roadmap and delivering measurable customer or business outcomes through cross-functional partnerships.
Strong technical judgment across model design, architecture, experimentation, and cloud infrastructure, with the ability to balance performance, speed, and cost.

jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Director, Product Software Architecture and Engineering to build and lead a new dev-ops team offering an AI and container management service for Equinix Managed Solutions. Duties include: Partner with product management to define requirements, service level objectives, and operational goals for the service; Integrate the service with global ordering and back-office systems to provide self-service; Work closely with EMS operations, EMS fulfillment, and Equinix network architecture to ensure the service design is compatible and well-integrated with existing infrastructure; Operate the service at an enterprise availability level as it scales out.

Service Strategy & Platform Leadership

Creates and drives broad stakeholder communications with respect to portfolio status and budget utilization

Drives adoption of best practices and standards

jobs.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

Job Profile Summary

The Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Security Engineering is a senior leadership role responsible for setting the strategic direction and overseeing the execution of security engineering initiatives across the organization. This individual will build a team of distinguished engineers and principals who focus on developing security solutions across priority technology areas, including AI, Cloud, Data and more. This role demands a strong blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and people leadership to ensure robust security is embedded throughout the technology lifecycle and to protect the association from evolving threats. This role also requires executive influence skills to partner with other engineering, architecture and development roles from across the technology organization.

The AVP will lead a high performing team, foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and act as a key subject matter expert influencing cross-functional security efforts.

This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel. However, individuals residing within a 60-mile radius of a USAA office will be expected to work on-site 4 days per week.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Security Engineering Leadership:
Define and drive the security engineering strategy, ensuring security requirements are integrated into all aspects of the solution/application enablement and sustainment lifecycle.
Collaborate with architecture to help define the strategic direction for cross-functional and highly complex key technologies within specific security domains.
Lead the research, analysis, and troubleshooting of highly complex security issues, systems, tools, and vendor integrations, identifying, resolving, and reporting on them.
Advance professional development through active participation in industry organizations, publications, educational opportunities, networking, and professional societies.

Technical Design & Development:
Design, develop, code, integrate, and test complex, cross-functional technical solutions with a primary focus on security, often collaborating with engineers and architects outside of the immediate team/department.
Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices within their security domain to ensure highly available, performant, and secure systems.
Lead the implementation of event-driven security architectures, methods, and controls.
Advise on security architecture, methods, and controls required to meet security, compliance, and audit requirements.

People Leadership & Development:
Lead, mentor, and guide a team of security engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning, professional growth, and collaboration.
Ensure the team stays current with the latest security trends and technologies through ongoing development and training.
Conduct code and design reviews to ensure effective operations, accurate planning, and adherence to security best practices.
Drive engineering efficiencies within the team.

Risk Management & Compliance:
Identify and manage existing and emerging risks stemming from business activities, ensuring risks are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
Collaborate with Security Analysts, IT, and Business Partners to tune, harden, and enhance security solutions and technologies to counter the latest trends and threats.
Ensure Information Security is integrated across the association by conducting comprehensive technology research to evaluate potential vulnerabilities in company systems.

Cross-Functional Influence:
Influence and lead cross-functional efforts across the organization as a subject matter expert in their security domain.
Work closely with IT and Business Partners to ensure security solutions align with business objectives.

Operational Excellence:
Independently resolve complex production issues and lead troubleshooting of end-to-end solutions that span multiple applications and systems.
Install, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain hardware and software related to security infrastructure.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
Experience:
10 years of related experience in Security Engineering and/or Information Technology with a strong security focus.
6 years of people leadership experience in building, managing and developing high-performing engineering teams, including performance management, coaching, and professional development.
Ability to foster a positive and high-performing team culture.
Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop junior engineers.
Proven experience leading and driving company-wide technology projects or initiatives.
Demonstrated experience leading and owning security strategies, solutions, and/or initiatives, with a proven ability to drive these efforts to successful completion.
Advanced experience with modern programming/scripting languages and frameworks.
Extensive experience designing, implementing, and leading security engineering activities utilizing modern DevSecOps practices.
Demonstrated ability to address complex production issues by effectively troubleshooting applications and systems.
Experience working with platform engineering concepts, including security best practices in infrastructure/policy as code, security architecture design patterns, security vendor integrations, and CI/CD pipelines with built-in application security controls.
Experience leading the implementation of event-driven security architecture, methods, and controls.
Experience advising on security architecture, methods, and controls required to meet security, compliance, and audit requirements.
Familiarity with cloud and emergent technologies such as: Public Cloud, Containerization, Security Data Lakes, ML/LLMs, GenAI, etc.

Compensation range:
The salary range for this position is: $224,250-$403,650.

jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role:

The Unified Security and Exposure Management (USEM) team equips the modern CISO organization to see, prioritize, and remediate risk across the enterprise attack surface. We are looking for a leader to define the next generation of these product lines as AI-native by design, built for the post-mythos world reshaping how CISOs manage cyber risk, prioritize remediation, and operationalize security outcomes at scale. This is a very strategic position for our company. As a Sr. Director of Product Management you will lead product innovation, influence product direction, define architecture, and ensure the quality of enterprise-grade security products.
As a Sr. Director of Product Management, you will lead a team of Product Managers in the ideation, defining, designing, and development of the next generation of USEM. You will lead by example on the defining challenge of this space — building AI-native, agentic security operations that enterprises can trust to run at scale, grounded in the data, workflows, and integrations their security programs already depend on — solving complex business problems for the CISO organization in a high-energy, startup-like environment with experienced industry leaders and a highly collaborative team.
This role will require you to interface with large-enterprise customers, CISOs, and internal teams across the platform and security portfolio — understand the evolving needs of security teams and deliver reliable, scalable solutions that reduce risk. The successful candidate will have an established background in enterprise cybersecurity, a track record of defining product roadmaps focused on top-line growth and getting customers to value, strong technical depth & excellent communication skills.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. You understand what it takes to make AI dependable inside mission-critical enterprise workflows — the reliability, governance, and grounding in real data and systems that security operations demand.
Deep cyber domain expertise in one or more of CTEM (Continuous Threat Exposure Management), cloud security, vulnerability management, or SIEM — with real fluency in how a CISO organization operates, buys, and measures success.
Proven experience building and scaling enterprise-grade products sold to large enterprises, including a strong understanding of how to architect and build on large-scale platforms that leverage shared services.
Establish a compelling vision for USEM and provide thought leadership across the interconnected security portfolio.
Drive product roadmap to deliver innovation, collaborating closely with different product lines and driving to a common goal.
Work closely with architects and engineering directors to design reliable, secure, and scalable solutions while ensuring a frictionless user experience.
Comfortable with a data-driven approach in defining success metrics, prioritizing requirements, and communicating plan, progress, and success across a cross-functional team.
Excellent communication skills, ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to a variety of audiences
12+ years of product management, engineering, or relevant industry experience in high tech, enterprise software, or cybersecurity.
Desirable
AI or agentic product experience delivered inside enterprise workflows at scale — pairing governance, reliability, and explainability with modern AI capabilities.
Experience with the ServiceNow Platform or a comparable large-scale enterprise platform.
Direct experience developing or managing products in the CTEM, vulnerability management, cloud security, or SIEM space.
Experience leading a major platform transition, category-defining launch, or new-category creation in enterprise security software.

The opportunity

Organizations are connecting industrial operations, modernizing control environments and integrating OT with enterprise technology. These changes create new cybersecurity, resilience and regulatory challenges across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors.

As an OT Cybersecurity Senior Manager in Technology Consulting, you will lead client engagements that assess, design and improve cybersecurity for Operational Technology and Industrial Control System environments. You will combine practical OT security knowledge with engagement leadership, client advisory, team development and business development. You will work across engineering, operations, cybersecurity and technology teams to help clients protect critical operations while supporting safety, availability and reliability.

Your Key Responsibilities

Lead OT cybersecurity engagements, including maturity and risk assessments, architecture and configuration reviews, vulnerability assessments, security strategy, transformation roadmaps and implementation support.
Assess industrial environments that may include ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU, HMI, SIS and IIoT technologies, industrial networks and supporting infrastructure.
Guide the design and implementation of practical OT security controls, including network segmentation, zones and conduits, defense in depth, system hardening, secure remote access, asset visibility, security monitoring and incident response capabilities.
Apply recognized OT cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST SP 800-82. Apply NIST CSF and sector-specific requirements when relevant to the client environment.
Lead client workshops and technical discussions with operational, engineering, cybersecurity and executive stakeholders. Translate technical findings into clear operational and business risk implications.
Manage engagement scope, workplans, resources, risks, quality, timelines and budgets. Keep client and EY stakeholders informed of progress and expected outcomes.
Lead, coach and develop engagement team members. Review deliverables and promote a collaborative, quality-focused and safety-aware working environment.
Build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities where EY can provide additional value.
Support business development through proposals, client presentations, solution shaping, methodology development, thought leadership and reusable assets.
Stay current on OT threat activity, industrial vulnerabilities, evolving regulations, security technologies and leading practices.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Deep understanding of OT and ICS cybersecurity principles and the operational priorities that distinguish industrial environments from enterprise IT.
Ability to lead complex client engagements and communicate with plant, engineering, security and executive stakeholders.
Working knowledge of industrial network architectures, industrial protocols and security controls used in OT environments.
Ability to turn technical observations into practical, prioritized recommendations that consider safety, availability, reliability and business continuity.
Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, written communication and presentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Industrial Automation or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Approximately 8+ or more years of relevant cybersecurity, OT security, industrial automation or related experience.
Experience leading or managing OT cybersecurity assessments, architecture reviews, security improvement programs or implementation initiatives.
Practical knowledge of OT and ICS environments, industrial networking and systems such as SCADA, DCS, PLC, RTU or HMI.
Experience applying ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 or comparable OT cybersecurity guidance.
Experience developing high-quality client reports, presentations, roadmaps, security designs, policies, standards or implementation documentation.
Experience leading teams, managing client expectations and delivering work within agreed timelines and budgets.
Ability and willingness to travel based on client and project needs.

Ideally, you'll also have

Hands-on experience with OT monitoring, asset visibility or threat detection platforms such as Nozomi Networks, Claroty, Dragos, Armis, Microsoft Defender for IoT, Cisco Cyber Vision or comparable technologies.
Experience in one or more industrial sectors such as power and utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, chemicals, mining, transportation, water or other critical infrastructure.
Experience with OT incident response, cyber resilience, threat modeling, security testing or vulnerability management in industrial environments.
Relevant certifications such as GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443, GRID, CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCNA or comparable credentials.
Experience supporting pursuits, proposals, account development, methodology development or practice-building activities.

What We Look For

We are looking for professionals who combine OT and ICS technical credibility with practical consulting judgment. Successful candidates communicate clearly, collaborate across engineering, operations and cybersecurity teams, and deliver high-quality outcomes in complex industrial environments.

Walk On Ventures (WOV) is a strategic growth advisory and venture firm partnering with founders and executive teams who are building high-impact, scalable businesses. The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) is a full-time remote role responsible for defining and leading the overall technology vision and execution across Walk On Ventures and its portfolio companies. This role oversees software and product development initiatives, partners with founders and executive teams to design scalable architectures, and aligns technology strategy with business and venture goals. The CTO will manage technical roadmaps, guide project delivery, and ensure that systems, data, and infrastructure are secure, reliable, and built to scale. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders, mentoring technical leaders, evaluating emerging technologies in agentic AI and insurtech, and driving continuous improvement in engineering practices. The CTO will also support due diligence for investments, contribute to technology-related advisory engagements, and represent the firm’s technology perspective with clients and partners.
Qualifications

Strong background in Software Development and Product Development, with experience building and scaling modern, cloud-based applications.
Proficiency in IT Strategy and Architecture, including designing scalable, secure, and resilient systems aligned with business objectives.
Demonstrated Project Management skills, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder technology initiatives from concept to delivery.

Proven ability to operate as a strategic partner to founders and executive teams, translating business goals into actionable technology plans.
Leadership experience building and mentoring distributed engineering teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and innovation.

new_jobs.title: Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer
new_jobs.description:
Forequence is seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial technical leader to join as Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer. This is a founder partnership with meaningful ownership, not a conventional salaried executive role or outsourced development position.

The Opportunity

Unlike many early-stage opportunities, you will not be starting with only an idea. Forequence already has:

A clearly defined enterprise problem
A developed product vision
Proprietary indices, scoring methodologies, and assessment logic
A growing body of original global research
An early MVP
Ongoing enterprise pilot conversations
Leading research, strategy, positioning, commercial development, and go-to-market
The foundation for a differentiated and defensible category in organizational intelligence

About Forequence

Forequence is an enterprise intelligence platform that helps organizations detect human strain before it becomes burnout, attrition, disengagement, or execution failure. Organizations have become highly sophisticated at measuring productivity, performance, revenue, and output. They remain far less capable of understanding the human capacity sustaining those outcomes. Most workforce platforms tell companies what has already happened. Forequence is being built to help organizations see what is developing beneath the surface, understand where human capacity is under pressure, identify the conditions driving that pressure, and intervene before it becomes an expensive organizational failure. Through proprietary organizational indices, behavioral signals, AI-supported analysis, and enterprise intelligence, Forequence helps leaders make better decisions about people, performance, capacity, and risk.

Meaningful Founder Ownership

You will join as a genuine co-founder with meaningful equity and long-term participation in the value you help create. This is not an advisory title, symbolic ownership, or an employee role disguised as a founder opportunity. The right person will help shape the company's technology, product, strategy, team, fundraising, and future. Equity, vesting, responsibilities, decision rights, intellectual property, and founder expectations will be discussed transparently and formalized properly.

Build From a Stronger Starting Point

You will not be responsible for inventing the problem, researching the market from scratch, creating the brand, defining the initial methodology, and building the technology alone. Forequence already has a substantial body of developed intellectual property, research, scoring logic, product thinking, market positioning, and commercial direction. You will bring the technical depth required to transform those assets into a scalable enterprise platform.

Significant Product Influence

The platform is early enough for you to make foundational decisions. You will have meaningful authority over:

Product architecture
Technical strategy
AI and data infrastructure
Enterprise security and privacy
Engineering standards
Product development priorities
Technical hiring
Platform integrations
Scalability and defensibility
The long-term technology roadmap

A Timely Market Opportunity

Artificial intelligence is accelerating the speed, complexity, and intensity of work. As organizations invest more heavily in automation, productivity, and performance technologies, they will also need better intelligence about the people operating alongside those systems. The central question is no longer only whether companies can increase output. It is whether they can understand the human capacity required to sustain that output. Forequence is positioned at the intersection of enterprise AI, workforce intelligence, organizational performance, people analytics, and human sustainability.

Build the Team and Culture From the Beginning

You will have the opportunity to recruit the early engineering and data team, establish the technical culture, and define how the company builds. You will not inherit a dysfunctional engineering organization, outdated infrastructure, or a deeply embedded development process. The early technical standards will be yours to help create.

The Partnership

As Co-Founder And CTO, You Will Work Directly With The Founder To Build Forequence Into a Scalable Enterprise Company. The Partnership Will Include

Meaningful co-founder equity
Shared responsibility for company direction
Direct influence over major product and business decisions
A clear division of ownership based on complementary strengths
Transparent founder agreements and vesting
Participation in fundraising and investor conversations
The opportunity to build and lead the technical organization
Long-term involvement in the commercial value created by the platform

What You Will Own

Technology — Define the architecture, engineering roadmap, infrastructure, development standards, and technical direction of Forequence.
Product Development — Translate proprietary research, indices, assessment logic, and enterprise requirements into a functional, intuitive, and commercially viable platform.
AI and Data — Develop the systems required to identify patterns, surface insights, support organizational decision-making, and responsibly incorporate AI into the product.
Security Readiness — Establish the security, privacy, governance, reliability, and technical controls required to serve enterprise customers.
Validation — Work directly with prospective customers and pilot organizations to refine use cases, test assumptions, prioritize development, and improve the product.
Technical Team — Recruit, lead, and develop the early engineering, data, and technical product team.
Strategy — Contribute to product positioning, pricing, commercial strategy, partnerships, fundraising, and the long-term development of the company.
Capital — Participate in technical due diligence, investor conversations, fundraising strategy, and the articulation of Forequence's technological advantage.

Co-Founder Profile

About

You do not need to meet every requirement. We care more about depth, judgment, learning ability, founder mentality, and alignment than a perfect résumé. You may be a strong fit if you have:

Experience building and shipping complex software products
Worked as a technical founder, CTO, senior engineer, architect, or engineering leader
Strong hands-on technical capability
Experience building B2B SaaS, AI, analytics, data, HR technology, or enterprise platforms
A solid understanding of modern cloud infrastructure, APIs, databases, application architecture, and security
The ability to translate ambiguous problems into practical technical systems
Strong product judgment
Experience working directly with customers or enterprise stakeholders
The ability to recruit and lead technical talent
An understanding of startup constraints and disciplined prioritization
High standards, intellectual honesty, and low ego
The willingness to make a serious long-term commitment to building Forequence

Particularly Relevant Experience

Experience In Any Of The Following Would Be Valuable

Enterprise SaaS
Applied AI or machine learning
Data analytics platforms
People analytics
HR technology
Workforce intelligence
Organizational network analysis
Predictive or risk intelligence
Data visualization
Privacy-sensitive technology
SOC 2 readiness
GDPR or PIPEDA compliance
Enterprise integrations
Early-stage fundraising
Scaling engineering teams

A Note

We are looking for someone who can distinguish between what is technologically impressive and what is commercially necessary.

Strong technical leadership and communication skills, with the ability to operate at both the strategic and hands-on levels.

Work Schedule
: Full-time, M-F, 40 hours per week
Compensation
: Salary range of $170,000.00 annually
Position Summary:

The Technology Director is a strategic and hands-on leader responsible for shaping and executing the organization’s technology vision to maximize operational efficiency and organizational impact. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, this role oversees the planning, implementation, and management of technology systems that support fundraising, grantmaking, operations, and communications. The ideal candidate will act as an internal technology champion, leveraging their expertise to optimize systems—including a complex, highly customized Salesforce environment—while guiding responsible adoption of emerging technologies such as AI. This role demands a collaborative leader with strong systems thinking skills, capable of working cross-functionally to identify opportunities for process improvement, data integrity, and innovative solutions.
Key Responsibilities:

Technology Strategy & Leadership:
Develop and implement a forward-thinking technology roadmap aligned with organizational goals. Assess needs, recommend scalable solutions, and lead initiatives to upgrade hardware and software systems.
Salesforce Management:
Serve as the internal Salesforce expert, overseeing customization, reporting, dashboard development, workflow automation, and system integrations. Proactively manage system updates and data quality.
Systems Administration & Integration:
Configure and maintain system settings, security, and user roles across various platforms. Ensure seamless integration between Salesforce, email marketing tools, contracts management systems, and the organization’s website.
Partnership & Vendor Management:
Liaise with external vendors and MSPs to manage technology partnerships, hardware lifecycle, cybersecurity, and troubleshooting. Oversee ongoing system maintenance, upgrades, and security protocols.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Training:
Partner with teams to leverage technology in streamlining workflows and advancing organizational objectives. Lead staff training on new systems and document processes for knowledge sharing.
Innovation & Adoption of Emerging Tech:
Stay informed on emerging technologies such as AI, evaluating their potential to enhance staff productivity and organizational impact. Lead the organization’s responsible integration of these tools.
Staff Support & Role Modeling:
Provide responsive technical support, foster a culture of continuous learning, and promote best practices across teams.
Additional Duties:
Manage related responsibilities as assigned to ensure a secure, efficient, and innovative technology environment.

Required Qualifications:

Deep knowledge of enterprise technology systems, cybersecurity, data management, and emerging tech trends including AI.
Proven experience supporting and administrating platforms such as Salesforce, Tableau, Box, Klaviyo, and similar tools.
Demonstrated success developing and executing comprehensive technology strategies that align with organizational priorities.
Strong systems thinking, project management, and change management skills, with a track record of leading complex initiatives.
Excellent communication and collaborative leadership skills, capable of translating technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences.
Salesforce Development and Administrator certifications are preferred.
A bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience with at least 3-5 years in a senior technology leadership role.

Preferred Skills & Experience:

Experience supporting nonprofit or mission-driven organizations.
Background in AI integration and automation solutions.
Familiarity with Vendor and MSP relationship management.
Ability to work effectively in a hybrid work environment.
Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and a proactive approach to technology innovation.

As a Senior Manager in the R&I Independence Technology Team (ITT), you will play a pivotal role in maintaining regulatory compliance and managing risks for clients, providing advice and solutions. With increased autonomy, you will apply sound judgment, recognizing when to take action and when to escalate. Your ability to develop and sustain high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams, and your commitment to excellence, contributes to the success of our firm.

You will apply systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities, validate outcomes with stakeholders, and share alternative perspectives. Your leadership will guide the team through complexity, demonstrating composure through ambiguous, challenging, and uncertain situations.

Responsibilities

Leading enterprise risk management initiatives to identify and mitigate potential risks impacting organizational operations and objectives
Developing business strategies to effectively manage risks in a rapidly changing environment
Applying analytical thinking to assess business risk and implement mitigation measures
Crafting and conveying clear, impactful messages that tell a holistic story to stakeholders
Directing teams through complex situations, demonstrating composure and strategic questioning
Validating outcomes with stakeholders and acting on feedback to improve risk management processes
Modeling and reinforcing professional and technical standards, including the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements
Initiating open and honest coaching conversations to develop high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams
Utilizing business process improvement techniques to enhance internal controls and regulatory compliance
Building relationships with business leaders to identify and address risk challenges effectively

What You Must Have

At least a High School Diploma or the equivalent degree
At least 6 years of experience

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Finance, Risk Management/Insurance
Demonstrating advanced skills in Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
Utilizing Business Process Improvement techniques to drive results
Applying systems thinking to identify underlying problems and opportunities

Leading teams through complexity with composure and strategic questioning
Developing and sustaining diverse and inclusive high-performing teams

new_jobs.description:
Compensation Range

$180,000 - $200,000 / Year

Position Overview:

Eligible for a hybrid work schedule split between home & office, with a minimum of 3 days in the office each week.

As our Senior Manager, Marketing Technology (MarTech), you'll lead the day-to-day management, optimization, and evolution of our marketing technology and loyalty ecosystem.

In this highly visible role, you'll help shape the future of personalization, customer engagement, loyalty, CRM, and AI-enabled marketing capabilities. Working closely with partners across Marketing, Technology, Analytics, Finance, Loyalty, and Operations, you'll ensure our platforms, data, and processes are integrated and optimized to deliver meaningful business results and memorable guest experiences.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You Are

Passionate about leveraging technology, data, and personalization to create engaging customer experiences.
A strategic thinker who can connect technology capabilities to business outcomes.
Equally comfortable leading initiatives and executing hands-on work.
A strong collaborator who enjoys partnering across multiple functions and levels of the organization.
Curious about emerging technologies and excited by the potential of AI-enabled marketing.
Skilled at translating complex technical concepts into practical business solutions.
Organized, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Motivated by continuous improvement, innovation, and delivering measurable results.

Here’s more of what you’ll get to do:

Martech & Loyalty Platforms Management

Support the execution, management, and ongoing optimization of marketing technology and loyalty platforms, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud, SessionM, personalization tools, analytics integrations, and customer data solutions.
Partner with business and technology teams to translate business needs into platform enhancements, technical requirements, implementation plans, and operational processes.
Evaluate current and emerging technologies and recommend opportunities for innovation and future growth.
Ensure platforms are configured, maintained, and optimized to support business objectives and long-term scalability.

Team Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Provide day-to-day guidance, coaching, prioritization, and project management support for the MarTech team.
Act as a hands-on player-coach, balancing leadership responsibilities with direct involvement in platform administration, troubleshooting, testing, campaign execution, and journey development.
Collaborate closely with Marketing, Loyalty, Digital, Analytics, Guest Services, Restaurant Operations, Legal, Privacy, Technology, and Finance teams.
Help establish and maintain service levels for platform support, campaign delivery, guest issue resolution, and business requests.
Identify opportunities to maximize the value of existing technology investments while supporting evolving business needs.

Campaign Execution, Journey Management, & Lifecycle Marketing

Support and optimize email, SMS, push, in-app, and cross-channel marketing campaigns.
Leverage Salesforce Marketing Cloud capabilities including Journey Builder, Automation Studio, audience segmentation, campaign orchestration, and automated lifecycle journeys.
Partner with stakeholders to develop testing strategies, audience experimentation, and optimization initiatives.
Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention, conversion, and overall guest experience.

Personalization & Advanced Marketing Capabilities

Support the implementation of personalization initiatives and AI-enabled marketing capabilities.
Leverage customer behavior, loyalty insights, and predictive data to improve targeting and relevance.
Help enhance guest experiences through automation, personalization, and innovative marketing solutions.

CRM, Segmentation & Guest Data Activation

Oversee CRM and guest data activation processes across connected systems and platforms.
Execute audience segmentation strategies, control groups, holdout methodologies, and personalized campaign initiatives.
Partner with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, reporting processes, integrations, and audience availability.
Troubleshoot and resolve campaign, platform, and data-related issues.

Loyalty Platform Administration and Innovation

Partner on loyalty platform administration, including promotions, rewards, member segmentation, enhancements, and issue resolution.
Support future capabilities such as gamification, predictive offers, real-time personalization, and expanded digital engagement.
Help drive growth in Rewards participation, retention, engagement, and member lifetime value.

Martech Operations, Governance & Support

Maintain documentation, processes, and operating procedures across the MarTech and Loyalty ecosystem.
Monitor integrations between marketing platforms, loyalty systems, analytics solutions, and enterprise data environments.
Coordinate platform enhancements, campaign requests, operational improvements, and support activities.
Support reporting, business reviews, annual planning, governance initiatives, and ongoing optimization efforts.

What we require:

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Marketing, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in Marketing Technology, CRM, Loyalty Platforms, Marketing Automation, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Digital Marketing, Solution Architecture, or related disciplines.
Deep expertise managing and optimizing MarTech ecosystems, including CRM, loyalty, CDP, and marketing automation platforms.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and related customer engagement technologies.
Strong understanding of customer journey design, personalization strategies, and lifecycle marketing.
Experience with data architecture, system integrations, APIs, and enterprise-scale marketing technology environments.
Ability to design scalable MarTech solutions and support long-term technology roadmaps.
Proficiency with SQL, SSJS, AMPscript, HTML, and related technical tools.
Strong project management, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
Proven ability to partner effectively with business, technology, analytics, and finance teams.

What We Prefer

MBA, Master's degree in Data Analytics, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
Experience working with loyalty platforms such as SessionM, Capillary, Talon.One, or similar technologies.
Experience implementing and optimizing personalization and AI-driven marketing capabilities.
Background leading large-scale MarTech transformations, platform implementations, or ecosystem enhancements.
Experience in hospitality, restaurant, retail, travel, financial services, or other customer-focused industries with sophisticated loyalty programs.
Passion for innovation, customer engagement, and creating exceptional guest experiences through technology.

What we offer:

Eligible for annual bonus
Medical, Dental & Vision
Eligible for benefits first day of the month following date of hire
401K with company match
3 weeks of vacation which increases to 4 weeks starting in your 5th year
5 days of sick time per year (first year prorated)
Tuition Reimbursement of $2,500 for qualified programs
Adoption Assistance Benefit of $2,500
25%-35% discount when dining as a guest
Reusable gift card loaded annually for your dining enjoyment

Named to FORTUNE Magazine’s “100 Best Companies to Work For®” list every year since 2014, The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated is a leader in experiential dining. We are culinary-forward and relentlessly focused on hospitality. Delicious, memorable experiences created by passionate people—this defines who we are and where we are going.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Infrastructure Network Solutions
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

The Senior Director, Infrastructure Network Solutions will be responsible for ensuring the stability of our critical backbone, multi-cloud connectivity across AWS, Azure, and GCP, and our extensive network footprint spanning many sites.The successful candidate will spearhead all network transformation and engineering projects—including enhancements to our campus LAN, wireless, and SD-WAN infrastructure—while driving increased adoption of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). Additionally, this leader will drive initiatives in firewall and network security and will be responsible for setting a strategic roadmap to enhance customer experience, improve satisfaction, and reduce operating costs.

The Senior Director will be a key part of the Technology Operations leadership team within Quest Diagnostics, with the goal of improving and transforming the organization’s Infrastructure Network Solutions Team and processes.This position will collaborate and partner with internal stakeholders (e.g. IT Technology leadership, functional leaders, regional leaders, and subject matter experts) and external stakeholders (e.g., strategic suppliers and customers) to achieve mutual goals that support business objectives.

This will be a remote-based position.

Responsibilities

Innovation and Excellence

Serve as a relationship manager to key vendors to ensure compliance with vendor contracts, performance expectations (including operational, performance, and financial metrics).
Assist in the formulation and implementation of procedures and standards relating to outsourced and internal services.
Collaborates with Legal and IT Procurement organizations in reviewing Master Service Agreements (MSA), including the ability to review higher complexity services and contract language, related to business terms, to ensure protection of the Company and appropriate Service level agreements (SLA and SLOs).
Collaborate with other Vendor Management/Outsource Management teams to share best practices and consistent performance delivery.
Develop strategic Infrastructure Service Management roadmaps which will drive Infrastructure vision into actionable steps for the infrastructure leadership team.
Provide full lifecycle technical project leadership from requirements gathering through implementation and administration.
Communicate progress and collaborate with a wide variety of internal teams including product and business development, legal, support teams, architecture and deployment.
Collaborate with business leaders during the selection and onboarding process of enterprise solutions and service providers ensuring a smooth transition to appropriate supporting services and operational procedures.
Participate in M&A activities by partnering with Technology and business leaders to ensure proper support and integration of additional entities and services.
Responsible for the monitoring and communication of external and internal service interruptions, planned outages, and applicable system updates.
Develop or manage existing support metrics and report mechanisms to effectively measure team and application performance.
The delivery of innovative Technology Infrastructure and Operations end-to-end process designs and delivery with a focus on automation to reduce human errors.
Develop infrastructure management and operational strategies to optimize use of resources including creating growth forecasts, modeling investments in new capacity based on various growth scenarios and the type of capacity needed, and defining enterprise network and security service strategies and technology roadmaps.
Collaborate with business leaders across the organization to strengthen communications, address key issues, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement in products and services.
Lead cross-functional initiatives supporting infrastructure modernization and digital transformation.

Strategic Leadership

Present service performance, operational risks, cybersecurity posture, resiliency metrics, and transformation progress to executive leadership.
Manage operational and capital budgets while maximizing technology investments and service value.
Build strong partnerships with business leaders, technology stakeholders, and strategic service providers.
Mentor and develop high-performing technical and operational teams.

Vendor Management & Service Governance

Lead strategic relationships with global managed service providers, telecommunications carriers, cloud providers, and technology partners.
Negotiate and manage contracts, service-level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational governance frameworks.
Conduct executive business reviews and operational performance assessments.
Manage service escalations and ensure vendor accountability for service quality, security, availability, and compliance.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve service delivery and reduce operational costs.
Establish vendor scorecards, reporting metrics, and governance processes to measure operational effectiveness.
Provide executive oversight of outsourced network and infrastructure operations.
Ensure successful integration of service providers into enterprise operational processes.

Network Transformation & Managed Services

Develop target operating models, governance structures, service ownership models, and support frameworks.
Oversee knowledge transfer activities, operational readiness assessments, and service acceptance criteria.
Drive modernization initiatives including SD-WAN, cloud networking, wireless infrastructure, network automation, and digital transformation.
Develop strategic roadmaps supporting business growth, technology modernization, and operational efficiency.

Security Leadership & Zero Trust Strategy

Develop and execute enterprise Zero Trust security strategies.
Lead implementation of identity-centric security models, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and least privilege access controls.
Establish network segmentation and micro-segmentation strategies to reduce organizational risk.
Partner with cybersecurity leadership on firewall governance, security policy lifecycle management, access controls, risk management, compliance initiatives, and security architecture governance.
Drive adoption of Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), cloud security controls, and modern remote-access architectures.
Support cyber resilience and incident response programs through infrastructure security governance.
Ensure security requirements are integrated into all managed service provider contracts and operating models.

AI Operations & Intelligent Monitoring

Lead implementation of AI-driven monitoring, observability, and analytics platforms.
Utilize machine learning and predictive analytics to identify service degradation before business impact occurs.
Implement AIOps capabilities for intelligent event correlation, anomaly detection, and root cause analysis.
Develop automated remediation capabilities and self-healing operational processes.
Create executive dashboards providing real-time operational visibility and predictive insights.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies that improve reliability, security posture, service quality, and operational efficiency.
Leverage automation and advanced analytics to support proactive infrastructure management.

Process Optimization & Automation

Improve operational efficiency through intelligent automation and process simplification.
Reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR).
Develop measurable service improvement plans focused on reliability, customer satisfaction, and cost optimization.
Identify and eliminate operational inefficiencies through data-driven decision making.

High Availability & Critical Infrastructure Leadership

Ensure the design, operation, and governance of highly available network and security services supporting mission-critical business operations.
Establish availability, resiliency, and performance standards across all managed infrastructure services.
Develop and maintain infrastructure resiliency strategies for WAN, cloud, internet, remote access, wireless, and data center environments.
Oversee redundancy, failover, capacity planning, and performance optimization initiatives.
Lead major incident management and service restoration efforts for business-critical systems.
Ensure service providers consistently meet availability and performance commitments.
Drive investment strategies that improve infrastructure reliability and reduce operational risk.

Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree in a technology, scientific, or business-related field of study is strongly preferred.
At least 15 years of professional experience in IT with multiple technical disciplines such as System Management, Virtualization, Security, Networking, Network Management Operations, and Cloud. Healthcare industry experience is highly preferential.
A strong understanding of Infrastructure Services, Processes, and Technologies.
The ability to see ahead clearly; anticipate future consequences and trends accurately; broad knowledge and perspective; future orientation; can articulately paint credible pictures and visions of possibilities and likelihood; can create competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans.
Must possess strategic agility, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Participate in the development of the strategic information technology plan, processes and solutions, recommending strategies and processes that support the direction of the company.
The demonstrated ability to develop effective and ongoing relationships with Peer levels of the internal customer organizations.
Must possess a demonstrable track record of success delivering and supporting IT projects and organizations in a rapidly changing business climate and a proven ability to analyze budgets and proposals to identify value opportunities and negotiate best outcomes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to write proposals and whitepapers, act as a vendor liaison, deliver presentations to customers or client audiences or professional peers, and work closely with management across Technology and the organization as necessary.
Requires sound technological judgment and an enthusiasm for innovation tempered with a pragmatic assessment of the possible.
Adaptability to changes in the work environment, competing demands, delays, or the unexpected and the agility to change the approach or method to best fit the situations.
Must be able to travel up to 25%.

About The Team

Quest Diagnostics honors our service members and encourages veterans to apply.

While we appreciate and value our staffing partners, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Quest will not be responsible for paying agency fees for any individual as to whom an agency has sent an unsolicited resume.

Overview

Vi is seeking a Director of IT Systems and Cybersecurity to provide strategic leadership and operational oversight across our cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity program, enterprise technology environment, and on-premise physical systems.

Reporting to the Vice President of IT and Chief Information Security Officer, this highly visible leadership role will influence technology direction across the organization while ensuring the security, reliability, and operational integrity of systems supporting our corporate office and communities.

The Director will serve as the organization's subject matter expert across three critical areas:

Microsoft Azure, including Azure Virtual Machines, Entra ID, and cloud storage
The Microsoft cybersecurity stack and third-party security tools, including Managed Detection and Response and external Security Operations Center services
On-premise physical systems, including life safety, audiovisual, digital communications, building access and management, food and beverage, and security systems

Why Join Vi?**

Vi is proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work and one of Glassdoor's 100 Best Companies to Work For.

At Vi, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced leaders, contribute to meaningful work, and help shape experiences that positively impact the lives of older adults and their families.

Competitive pay which may include eligibility for discretionary bonus compensation subject to individual, department and company performance and the terms of the applicable bonus plan.
Comprehensive benefits package
Generous Paid Time Off beginning on day one
401(k) with company match
Paid maternity and paternity leave
Award-winning training and professional development
Tuition reimbursement
Luxury work environment
Meaningful, mission-driven work

In conjunction with the VP of IT and CISO, provides strategic direction for IT systems, cybersecurity, and infrastructure initiatives.
Responsible for directly supervising the IT Cybersecurity Analyst. Responsibilities include hiring, training and development, counseling, performance evaluation, functional development and disciplinary action.
Oversees vendor management, contract renewals, and service agreements for all technology areas within the role's scope, including Azure, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and on-premise physical systems. Partners with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and business stakeholders to support negotiations, monitor vendor performance, and ensure services align with business, security, compliance, and budget requirements.
Develops and maintains technology roadmaps for all areas within the role's scope, including Microsoft Azure, cybersecurity tools, enterprise infrastructure, and on-premise physical systems.
Establishes and maintains policies, procedures, standards, and documentation related to cybersecurity, IT systems, cloud infrastructure, and physical technology systems.
Works closely with onsite staff SMEs to manage and provide planning and project management oversight for MACs of these systems.

Microsoft Azure

Oversees the Microsoft Azure environment.
Performs needed MACs (Moves, Adds, Changes) for all Azure-related infrastructure.
Oversees technical design, planning, implementation, and support for Azure virtual infrastructure supporting enterprise applications, including Azure Virtual Machines, Entra ID, and cloud storage.

Cybersecurity Operations

Serves as Incident Response Manager for all cybersecurity events, including incident response planning and execution.
Directs the Company's security program, including monitoring the environment and ensuring regular patching and updating of all digital systems and equipment.

Oversees the Microsoft cybersecurity stack and related third party cybersecurity tools.
Oversees Azure security operations including Entra ID management and cloud security controls
Manages relationship with external SOC and ensures compliance with agreed-upon SLAs for threat detection and remediation.
Develops and maintains security metrics and reporting from these platforms to track security posture and team performance.

On-Premise Physical Systems

Oversees all on-premise physical systems at all locations needed for business operations, including Life Safety (Nurse Call, Lifeline, Wander management, etc.), Audio/Video, Digital Communications, Building Access Management, Building Systems Management, F&B Systems, and Security Systems. Works closely with risk and compliance teams to ensure all systems are in compliance with regulatory requirements.

Budget And Financial Oversight

Recommends and supports budgets for areas of responsibility, including Azure services, cybersecurity tools, infrastructure systems, physical technology systems, vendors, and related projects. Responsible for procurement and oversight of external resources required to assist with assigned projects.

Travel

This position requires 25% travel.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science is required. Master's degree preferred.
Work Experience: Minimum of 10 years progressive experience in IT infrastructure,

cloud, or cybersecurity roles, with a minimum of 4 years experience in a management or

leadership role in a corporate environment is required. Experience with Azure cloud

services, incident response, and multi-site IT systems is required.

Licensure / Certification: Advanced cyber security certifications (e.g. CISSP, GIAC,

CISM, CGEIT, CCSP, CISA) and Azure certifications (e.g. AZ-500, SC-100, SC-200, SC

300) preferred.

Leading the optics product and technology roadmap process, across all data center and networking platforms
Customer Engagement: Work directly with customers and developers to understand use cases, difficulties, and requirements, ensuring our solutions meet and exceed their expectations
Providing input and mentorship to architecture and development teams for optics and interconnects across switches, NICs and compute platforms
Identifying and evaluating new technologies, innovations, and partner relationships to align with our strategic technology roadmap
Thought Leadership: Produce informative technical content, including blogs, white papers, webinars, and tutorials, that emphasize the value and innovation of our optics and interconnect platforms

What We Need To See

BS/MS/PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Sciences, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)
15+ overall years of relevant industry experience, with 10 or more years in a leadership role.
Proven experience and solid understanding of optical interconnects, silicon photonics, lasers, or closely related technologies, within high-performance data center settings
Practical knowledge of Networking (switching & routing for Ethernet/Infiniband and/or compute fabrics), and Data Center infrastructure
Demonstrated experience and skills in building partnerships, managing business contracts, statements of work, and investment justifications

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Proven track record in product management or product marketing for optical transceivers, silicon photonics or co-packaged optics
Direct experience working with high performance data center networking or computing platforms
Background in formulating product strategies or specifying requirements related to networking or data center environments
Outstanding interpersonal skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 216,000 USD - 345,000 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Salesforce is seeking a proven, transformational executive to lead the evolution of our Global Partnerships Programs and Experience, solidifying our position as the best-in-class Partner Ecosystem.

Reporting directly to the EVP of Global Partnerships, this person will serve as the operations leader across our Strategic Technology and Global Consulting Partner businesses, supporting and developing a high-performing Partner organization that helps our customers become Agentic Enterprises.
