Excellent at identifying and nurturing talent and retaining high performers, and appropriately allocating resources of their team to drive the highest impact outcomes
Lead & Drive Individual Contributor Work - Beyond guiding top initiatives that the team supports, this person can roll-up their sleeves and own high priority initiatives through execution as needed

Required Experiences

Exceptional leadership, with a proven ability to influence and make strategic decisions
Exceptional engagement skills, inspiring confidence and alignment at all levels
Gritty self-starter with significant experience with enterprise application partner ecosystems
Deep knowledge and experience in the SaaS industry, Partner Programs, Partner Lifecycles, Incentive Programs, Sales Strategy, and third-party vendor teams
Track record of running or operating a scalable, programmatic go-to-market or partner business, with fluency in pipeline generation, bookings metrics such as NNAOV, and consumption-based selling models
Experience leading and retaining high-performing teams through go-to-market transformation
Highly collaborative, with a strong ability to influence and build consensus across teams
Thrives in fast-paced environments, demonstrating resourcefulness and the ability to succeed in the face of ambiguity while effectively prioritizing and managing competing responsibilities
Solution-oriented and data-driven, with a continuous learning mindset
Demonstrates integrity, high ethical standards, and sound judgment in all decision-making
A passion and proven experience in using AI to drive operational efficiencies and increased partner success
Advocate of diversity in teams, thought, and perspective

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

new_jobs.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

Job Description

The Director, Software Engineering
leads the Legal Engineering
delivery pillar within our Legal, Privacy & Compliance Engineering organization. You will lead the engineering team that build, integrate, and operate the technology powering our Legal department including, spanning contract lifecycle management, legal document management, eDiscovery and legal hold, intellectual property management, eBilling, and a growing portfolio of AI agentic workflows.

This is a build-and-lead role: you will own a portfolio that blends enterprise SaaS platforms with bespoke software and lead the engineering of the interoperability layer and differentiated custom applications that make the whole ecosystem greater than its parts.

This role requires both deep technical and leadership with business acumen in the corporate legal space. This leader will own the end-to-end delivery of legal technical solutions that enable capabilities across jurisdictions, partners directly with Product Management, Legal, and Cyber. This role will be responsible for hiring, retaining, and continuously assessing the health and growth of the legal engineering team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Engineering Leadership & Delivery
Leads a team of engineering managers, staff software engineers, and architects), plus contractors and interns
Own engineering delivery, technical health, reliability, and quality across the legal technology portfolio — SaaS platforms, custom applications, integrations, and data flows
Drive engineering excellence: architecture reviews, code quality, CI/CD, automated testing, and operational readiness
Steer programs at the right altitude — owning key decisions, pro-active escalations, and delivery health in partnership with our Technical Program Management and Product Management functions
Establish and uphold software quality, legal architecture and engineering standards, and NBCU cyber guidelines
Drive delivery across multiple complex concurrent programs/projects
Partner with Principal architect, scrum lead, product owner, and technical project manager to ensure standards and stakeholder visibility

Platform Ownership
Provide technical leadership across contract lifecycle management, legal document management, eBilling, intellectual property management, and eDiscovery/legal hold capabilities
Lead the strategy and engineering for interoperability between SaaS platforms and bespoke software — APIs, data integration, workflow orchestration, and shared services
Ensure solutions meet enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and data governance standards

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence
Serve as the senior technical voice for Legal engineering
Communicate program status, risk exposure, and engineering trade-offs to SVPs, VPs and Directors in a clear and business relevant terms
Represent the organization in regulatory discussions, 3rd party audits, and external partner engagements as needed
Build a deep, strategic partnership with our Product organization — embedded in roadmap conversations, contributing engineering perspective to business process design in way of shift left mindset
Engage directly with Legal department and Legal Operations leaders; translate their operational needs into reliable, scalable and secure engineering solutions
Partner with our Principal Architect on technical standards fit for purpose design principles and with Cyber on secure integration practices while securing the perimeter protecting the brand, consumer’s rights, and data

System Reliability & Performance:
Proactively manage reliability and performance of all systems to ensure they meet global business needs. Partner closely with SaaS providers and internal teams to maintain system health and performance.
Defect & Enhancement Management:
Manage the defect management process from identification to resolution. Manage the delivery of enhancements that improve user experience and system efficiency.
Problem & Incident Management:
Own the problem management process, conducting root cause analysis to reduce the number of recurring incidents. Focus on implementing minor enhancements or process changes to prevent future issues. Manage the end-to-end response to major incidents impacting Legal business processes. Manage RCA sessions and ensure timely executive – level communications. Reduce “noise” in the system by analyzing ticket trends and automating routine fixes.
Support Standards & SLAs:
Enforce global support standards and best practices including adherence to SLAs for all support activities. Monitor and report on performance metrics (e.g. MTTR, backlog aging) and use data to drive continuous improvements.
Data Integration:
Manage the support and maintenance of data integrations between enterprise systems.
People Leadership
Hire, develop, retain, and coach engineering managers, staff engineers, and architects; build a high-trust, high-accountability team culture
Grow your leaders through honest feedback, career development, and intentional coaching

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent experience.
12+ years of experience in software engineering with 7+ years in engineering management or senior technical leadership
5+ years of experience leading ML and automation solutions
3+ years of hands-on experience with AI including, building or leading agentic workflows and/or agent orchestration
Demonstrated deep legal technology experience delivering technology in a large enterprise environment
Working knowledge of application security fundamentals - SSO/IAM, API security, secure SDLC, and security review practices when integrating SaaS
Strong track record of leading cross-functional programs with legal stakeholders
Proven ability to influence and communicate at S/VP levels
Experience managing and growing engineering teams (software engineers + managers) in a matrixed Fortune 100 or equivalent environment

Fully Remote: 
This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $180,000 - $230,000  (bonus + LTI eligible)

Additional Information

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. About The Weather Company:

The Weather Company is the world’s leading weather provider, helping people and businesses make more informed decisions and take action in the face of weather. Together with advanced technology and AI, The Weather Company’s high-volume weather data, insights, advertising, and media solutions across the open web help people, businesses, and brands around the world prepare for and harness the power of weather in a scalable, privacy-forward way. The world’s most accurate forecaster globally, the company reaches hundreds of enterprise clients and more than 360 million monthly active users via its digital properties from The Weather Channel (weather.com) and Weather Underground (wunderground.com).

AI is part of how we work:

Human judgment, expertise, and creativity remain essential and are amplified by AI. We expect everyone in this role to use AI thoughtfully and proactively to accelerate their performance, improve the quality of their work, and explore new possibilities. We are looking for people who are curious, adaptable, and excited to help shape an AI-enabled culture that delivers better outcomes for our customers and our company.
Job brief:

We are seeking an experienced and vision-driven Senior Manager, DevOps Engineering to lead, mentor, and scale our global DevOps, SRE, and Infrastructure engineering teams. In this role, you will champion modern engineering culture, drive cloud modernization, and ensure our infrastructure is secure, highly available, and resilient.
You will partner closely with Software Engineering, Product, Security, and IT Operations to deliver zero-downtime releases, mature our CI/CD and IaC practices, and establish robust release and environment management frameworks.
The impact you'll make:

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing global team of DevOps engineers, Site Reliability Engineers (SREs), and infrastructure engineers, to lead transformation and foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

new_jobs.description:
*Our secret to leading the way in hospitality? We put our people first!*

At Shake Shack, our mission is to Stand For Something Good in all that we do. From our teams to our neighborhoods, we're committed to always doing the right thing. As one of the fastest-growing hospitality brands, we're all about crafting unforgettable experiences for our guests. We offer endless learning opportunities and the chance to make a lasting impact on our business, restaurants, and communities. As a member of the #ShackFam, you’ll have access to hands-on mentorship, training, and growth potential, all in a fun and inclusive environment.

Join us and Be a Part of Something Good.

*Location: Home Office - NYC or ATL*

*Hybrid 3x a week in office.*

*Job Summary*

The Senior Manager, Workday Technology Lead serves as the strategic technology leader for Shake Shack’s Workday platform and primary subject-matter expert for the platform’s integrations, security, data, and overall optimization. The role oversees the end-to-end flow of information across Workday and key enterprise systems, translating business needs into scalable solutions that support the organization’s people, financial, and operational priorities. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines technical

execution with accountability for the quality, reliability, and delivery of solutions developed by internal teams and external partners. The role leads priorities, work allocation, solution reviews, and delivery across a global team while maintaining a strong understanding of Workday’s capabilities and business processes. The role partners closely with business and technology stakeholders to drive continuous improvement, ensure effective platform performance, and deliver solutions that meet Shake Shack’s evolving business needs.

*Job Responsibilities and Duties*

*Integration Development & Lifecycle Ownership*

Design, build, deploy, monitor, and debug Workday integrations using Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Document Transformation, and REST/SOAP APIs across payroll, banking, benefits, POS, supply chain, procurement, and analytics.
Own the integration catalog, error-handling framework, and daily run health end to end

*Technical Solutioning & Design*

Partner with Finance, People Resources, and Operations to translate requirements into solution designs, data mappings, interface specifications, and effort estimates.
Evaluate build-vs-configure-vs-middleware options, recommend the approach, and lead technical design reviews with the partner and downstream system owners.

*Technical Delivery Management*

Own the day-to-day delivery of internal technical resources and the partner teams — intake triage, backlog prioritization, work assignment, quality gates, and production rollout.
Hold partners accountable to committed delivery and outcome-based standards through design and code peer review and signoff.

*Data Platform & Custom Application Delivery*

Build and support Prism Analytics ingestion pipelines and derived datasets, and deliver Workday Extend applications and orchestrations.
Own bi-directional data flows between Workday, Adaptive Planning, and the enterprise data warehouse (Snowflake).

*AI Agents & Intelligent Automation*

Configure, integrate, test, and deploy approved Workday AI agents, Illuminate features, and automation use cases — including the data access and integration required to support them.

*Release, Regression & Integration Controls*

Execute Workday semi-annual release readiness for the integration and data layer — impact assessment, regression test build and execution, sandbox refresh coordination, migration packaging, and cutover.
Maintain integration runbooks, technical documentation, and ISU/ISSG security; execute assigned SOX/ITGC control activities and produce audit evidence.

*Required Experience*

7+ years of enterprise application delivery, including 5+ years hands-on Workday technical delivery and integration build — not oversight-only.
Current, demonstrable experience with Workday Financials and HCM and the broader Workday business process and security framework.
Proven ability to independently develop and debug Workday integrations using Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Document Transformation, and REST/SOAP APIs.
Hands-on Workday security administration — domain and business-process security policies, role- and userbased security groups, and access review/audit.
Experience leading global partner teams and internal teams — assigning work, reviewing deliverables, and holding partners to committed turnaround.
Track record owning production integration health — monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root-cause remediation.
Experience leading Workday semi-annual release management, including regression testing and featureadoption assessment.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to translate business requirements directly into working, tested solutions.

*Preferred Experience*

8+ years enterprise application experience with 6+ years hands-on Workday; Workday certifications in Integration/Studio, Extend, Security, Financials, or HCM.
Hands-on Workday Extend development (custom apps, orchestrations, API-driven extensions) and deployment/tuning of Workday AI agents, Illuminate, or ML-driven automation in a production tenant.
Working experience with Adaptive Planning (model structure, sheets, data loads) and Prism Analytics (ingestion, transformation, blended datasets).
Experience with middleware/iPaaS (Boomi) and integrating Workday with identity management (Azure AD/Entra ID).
SOX ITGC execution and internal/external audit support; Agile delivery with Jira andTSM/case-management workflows.
Experience delivering the technical workstream of finance and HR transformation initiatives —implementations, migrations, and process automation — within established enterprise architecture and integration standards.
Restaurant, retail, hospitality, or other multi-unit environments with high-volume labor and back-of-house data.

*Knowledge, Skills, Abilities*

*Key Success Measures*

Speed to Market & Timeliness: Achieve a >90% on-time delivery rate against approved, baselined business commitments for Workday and connected-system enhancements.
Platform Stability & Continuity: Maintain >99.9% availability for critical Workday integrations and services, with zero Severity 1 incidents or change-related business disruptions during protected business windows, including payroll processing, financial period close, and open enrollment.
Integration Health: Maintain >99.6% successful and on-time delivery of business-critical integrations, with zero unresolved business-impacting failures to downstream systems and >80% of integration errors detected and resolved by the Enterprise team before they affect business operations or are reported by business partners.
Platform Innovation & Automation ROI: Successfully deploy at least 2-3 targeted automation initiatives or new platform capabilities each year such as Workday Extend, AI agents, or Illuminate features, resulting in a documented 15% or greater reduction in manual processing time, recurring technical support tickets.

*Leadership Characteristics*

Operates with deep ownership of technical delivery outcomes and production health.
Hands-on and detail-driven — leads by building, not only directing.
Direct, decisive, and outcome-focused.
Holds internal and partner resources to high standards of quality and turnaround.
Communicates clearly and credibly with technical and business stakeholders alike

*Education or Certificate Details*

Workday certification preferred, not required

*Education Requirements*

Bachelor's degree or higher

Benefits At Shake Shack

A work environment where you can come as you are, share your ideas, have fun, and work collaboratively:

Weekly Pay and Performance bonuses
Shake Shack Meal Discounts
Exclusive corporate discounts for travel, electronics, wellness, leisure activities and more

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance*

* Employer Paid Life and Disability Insurance*

* 401k Plan with Company Match*

* Paid Time Off*

* Paid Parental Leave*

Access to Employee Assistance Program on Day 1
Pre-Tax Commuter and Parking Benefits

* Flexible Spending and Dependent Care Accounts*

Development and Growth Opportunities
Eligibility criteria applies

Click the "*Apply*" button above to apply for this opening.

*About Us*

Beginning as a hot dog cart in New York City’s Madison Square Park, Shake Shack was created by Danny Meyer, Founder and CEO of Union Square Hospitality Group and best-selling author of Setting the Table. Shack Fans lined up daily, making the cart a resounding success, and donating all proceeds back to the park beautification efforts. With our roots in fine dining and giving back to the community, we are committed to high quality food served with a high level of hospitality. Our team members enjoy a positive work environment that is deeply committed to the philosophy that we "Stand for Something Good."

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Database Platform
new_jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

What You'll Do

You will lead the Database Platform team — the engineering team responsible for the data infrastructure that underpins every NodeZero pentest, finding, and report. NodeZero operates at scale: millions of discovered assets, tens of millions of vulnerability findings, and audit-critical data that our customers rely on to remediate risk. The Database Platform team owns the design, operation, and reliability of our core data layer — currently PostgreSQL as the primary store and Neo4j for the asset graph, with time-series and analytical stores on the roadmap as NodeZero's data volume and use cases grow. You will lead a team of ~8 engineers including a Principal Engineer, and you will build this team from a strong foundation into a fully staffed, world-class data platform organization.

Team Building & Culture: Hire, mentor, and grow the Database Platform team to full capacity. Establish database engineering norms and a culture of ownership for engineers who share responsibility for the most critical data layer in our stack.
Data Architecture: Partner with the Principal Engineer to define the technical direction for NodeZero's data platform — schema design standards, query patterns, migration strategies, and scalability principles.
Reliability & Operations: Own SLOs for database availability, query latency, and data integrity across production environments. Drive oncall maturity and runbook quality.
Data Modeling & Schema Governance: Establish schema review processes and data modeling standards. Ensure NodeZero's data model evolves cleanly as new pentest capabilities ship.
Cross-team Partnership: Collaborate with Data Ingestion, Security Research, and API Platform teams to align on data contracts, API design, and pipeline dependencies.
Act as a Product Owner: Translate data platform needs from Security Research and Product into a clear, prioritized engineering roadmap.

What You'll Bring

Data Platform Leadership & Architecture

Demonstrated experience leading teams that design, scale, and operate relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and hybrid data stores (graph, time-series, or document) in production at scale.
Experience defining schema migration strategies for high-velocity production environments with zero-downtime requirements.
Experience with multi-tenant data architectures: customer data isolation, row-level security, and data residency concerns.
Strong understanding of database performance: query optimization, indexing strategies, EXPLAIN analysis, and connection pooling.

Team Building & Engineering Culture

Experience building or significantly growing an engineering team — including hiring, onboarding, and establishing engineering norms tailored for data-intensive systems.
Proven ability to define and instill engineering culture: rigorous schema review, data integrity standards, operational runbooks, and oncall rotation.
Drives high-impact architecture decisions rigorously — requires design documents, runs structured reviews, builds consensus across platform teams.
Able to partner effectively with a Principal Engineer and leverage their technical leadership without diminishing team ownership.

Technical Expertise

Proficient in Go, Python, or SQL (deep expertise).
Production experience with PostgreSQL at scale: partitioning, logical replication, pg_bouncer/pgpool, read replicas.
Experience with AWS data services: RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, or equivalent.
Familiarity with graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) or time-series stores (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB) is a strong plus.
Kubernetes and containerized database operations — stateful workload management.

Nice to Haves

Background in cybersecurity data, threat intelligence feeds, or vulnerability databases.
Experience with data platform compliance: SOC 2, FedRAMP, or GDPR/CCPA data handling requirements.
Familiarity with analytical query patterns: BI tooling, OLAP workloads, or customer-facing analytics.
Experience operating databases in multi-region or active-active configurations.

Travel Required

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 5% of travel to be successful.

Compensation And Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State's transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

Base salary range: $242,250 - $275,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.
Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

Perks of Horizon3

Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.
Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.
Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.
Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.
Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Manager, B2B, Marketing Technology
new_jobs.description:
About The Team

DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. The Marketing Technology team is responsible for delivering best-in-class tools, data, and processes so teams at DoorDash can effectively acquire new customers, drive retention, and grow new business lines across all our audiences. Our mission is to enable teams to deliver personalized, engaging, and relevant content across all our owned and paid channels. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Analytics teams to translate Marketing’s technology needs into measurable business outcomes for our Growth and Performance Marketing teams.

The B2B Marketing Technology team does this for DoorDash's business customers. It owns marketing automation, the B2B websites, and the data flows between the tools used by our marketing and sales teams.

About The Role

We're seeking a Senior Manager to lead B2B Marketing Technology at DoorDash. You will own the B2B marketing technology stack: our marketing automation platform, its connection to sales tools, the B2B websites, and the data model and flows that connect them. You will set web and information architecture, define attribution priorities, close data gaps, and redesign our B2B marketing system architecture, building automations yourself when needed. You will lead the B2B MarTech team and partner with B2B Marketing, Go-to-Market Technology, Sales and Operations, Product, Engineering, and Data to set the long-term B2B marketing technology roadmap.

This role will report to the Director, Marketing Technology within the Growth Marketing organization.

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for B2B marketing automation across our business lines.
Design how leads move between HubSpot, Salesforce, and the data warehouse, including deduplication, scoring, routing, and lifecycle stages.
Define the marketing data model and attribution priorities with B2B Marketing, Sales and Operations, and Data, and close data gaps across web, marketing automation, CRM, and the warehouse.
Put monitoring, data quality standards, and governance in place so problems are caught before they affect campaigns, lead routing, or reporting.
Set web and information architecture for the B2B websites. This covers the CMS, forms, tracking, tag governance, and the move to AI-native site infrastructure. Define standards rather than fulfilling page requests one at a time.
Run an experimentation program on the B2B websites to improve conversion.
Make keep, add, build, and retire decisions on B2B marketing tools based on cost, usage, and business impact.
Own adoption of the B2B marketing stack, including the processes, training, and documentation that let B2B Marketing teams get full value from HubSpot and the B2B websites.
Lead and grow the B2B MarTech team across web platforms, web development, and marketing operations.
Partner with Go-to-Market Technology on architecture, system ownership, and the Salesforce roadmap.
Serve as B2B Marketing’s technical lead with Product and Engineering, building business cases and prioritizing requests so resources go to the highest-impact problems.
Advise marketing and go-to-market leadership on B2B marketing technology, with clear recommendations as goals and business needs change.
Report on speed of lead handoff to sales, lead-to-pipeline conversion, data reliability, and time to launch.

We’re Excited About You Because You Have…

8+ years in B2B marketing technology, marketing operations, or revenue operations, including 2+ years managing people across technical and operations roles.
Deep expertise with an enterprise marketing automation platform (such as HubSpot, Marketo, or Pardot) and Salesforce, and a strong technical understanding of how marketing systems connect: APIs, webhooks, data warehouses, CMS, and tag management. You can review a system design and identify risks.
Experience designing a marketing data model (objects, fields, lifecycle and lead status, deduplication) and setting attribution and data quality priorities.
Experience owning a B2B marketing website's architecture and improving conversion through experimentation.
Experience selecting and managing B2B marketing and sales tools (such as 6sense, ZoomInfo, Clay, or Chili Piper), including vendor and agency relationships and build, buy, or retire decisions.
A track record of turning marketing requirements into technical specifications with Product and Engineering, and of influencing senior stakeholders without authority by explaining tradeoffs clearly.
A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Nice to have: experience with data enrichment tools such as HubSpot Data Hub, querying data in Sigma or Tableau, and building automations or integrations, including with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.

Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash because…

We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day.
We are learners - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.
We are customer-obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.
We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

We expect this position to be filled by 08/12/2026

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See Below For Paid Time Off Details

For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.

$159,800—$235,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non-binary or gender non-conforming, LGBTQIA+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non-discrimination.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

new_jobs.title: VP Software Engineering
new_jobs.description:
The world needs 3 TW of new solar capacity every year. The legacy approach of developing and building infrastructure is mathematically incapable of catching up.

Planted is the autonomous power deployment company. We transform power plants from bespoke construction projects into manufactured products. By integrating planning software, high-density arrays, energy storage, and field robots, we deliver more power where it's needed most.

The physics are solved; what remains is relentless execution. Led by repeat founders and an engineering core from SpaceX and Tesla, we are backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Piva Capital, Google, Gigascale Capital, Khosla Ventures, and RA Capital Management.

We’re scaling fast and looking for operators and engineers who want to own real pieces of the system. You don't need a traditional energy background; we care whether you can finish hard things. Come build with us.

About The Role

Software is both the brains of our machines and the connective tissue of Planted operations. You will lead and grow a software organization spanning three domains: autonomous robotic vehicle software, our suite of web-based power plant design, build, and operate tools, and an emerging portfolio of AI agents that automate engineering, estimation, and operations workflows.

We are looking for a pragmatic technical leader with a track record of building high-performing, multi-disciplinary software teams. You must be deep enough technically to drive key architectural decisions across the vertically integrated platform, and strategic enough to drive and execute on the product roadmap. You have systems literacy (e.g., how data moves from a robot's camera into an ML pipeline) and prioritize delivery mechanics over heavy-handed project management. Our robots are building projects in the field today and our design software is in front of customers. Your mandate is to scale the product and the team to support our current 10x year over year growth in megawatts deployed.

The Team:
You will join a group at the intersection of deep tech and massive physical infrastructure. Our engineering core brings robotics and automation DNA from SpaceX and Tesla, working directly alongside veteran energy developers. We are led by repeat founders with a successful prior exit (Cogenra to SunPower). Planted is backed by leading investors in energy and Physical AI, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Piva Capital.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is $275,000-$325,000 plus a meaningful equity stake and benefits. Pay within the range is based on candidate experience, job-specific skills, and education. The target experience for the position is 10–15+ years. We work together in person 5 days/week at our HQ in Oakland, CA.

Key Responsibilities

Organizational Leadership & Talent Development: Build, scale, and mentor a high-performing, multi-level software organization, including direct management of engineering managers, principal engineers, and system architects. Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous growth. Recruit and retain top-tier software talent across cloud, spatial/CAD, embedded, and robotics domains while allowing technical experts to own the architecture.
Strategic Execution & Stakeholder Management: Own the software roadmap and drive the predictable, on-time delivery of complex, multi-system software projects across multiple products. Set clear expectations, communicate progress, and align software deliverables. Collaborate seamlessly with the Commercial team, Hardware Engineering, and Project Operations. Make the build-vs-buy, stack, and platform decisions that will hold up at 100x scale.
Software Product Suite Ownership: Lead development across our core platforms: Power Planter (automated layout, engineering, and costing), Build View (autonomous fleet management, field deployment, and QA/QC), and Operate View (inspection, operations, and maintenance tools for large-scale solar plants).
Autonomous Robotic Vehicle Platforms: Lead the engineering teams deploying the full software stack across our autonomous field machine fleet (fleet logic, behavior trees, and path planning, modern and classical controls, ROS2, etc.).
Data Flywheel: We operate our field machines like modern manufacturing lines. You will own the telemetry and data infrastructure that monitors production with statistical process control and turns every installation into training data for better models and improved machine productivity.
AI Systems: Build the team and roadmap for AI agents that automate design, estimation, project delivery, and operations workflows, grounded in the data our robots and projects generate.

Qualifications

10 to 15+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams (senior ICs and managers) shipping production systems.
Deep expertise in full stack software development involving hardware and software integration like robotics, IoT, or industrial automation.
Track record shipping robotics, autonomous vehicles, or hardtech software into the field at scale—with a strong focus on fleet reliability, continuous testing, and real-time observability.
Broad leadership capability across platform/full-stack teams, cloud infrastructure, data systems, or applied AI/ML groups outside your core specialty.
Systems architecture judgment with strong understanding of how technologies work together (e.g., middleware, pub/sub architectures, web services, and ML pipelines). You do not need to write the C++ on the robot, but you must understand edge compute, latency, and hardware-in-the-loop testing.

Preferred Qualifications

Field robotics: Experience in construction, agriculture, mining, defense, logistics, or autonomous vehicles operating off-pavement (e.g., Waymo, Cruise, Bedrock Automation).
DevOps & Delivery: Strong understanding of modern software deployment and containerization (Docker). Experience with CI/CD, release pipelines, and edge deployment strategies, focusing on how code reliably gets to the machine.
Agentic and AI-Augmented Software Engineering: Experience building, rebuilding, and managing AI-integrated software development platforms and teams.
Robotics & Controls: Familiarity with the complexities of deploying field-robotics software (e.g., ROS2, vehicle navigation, and autonomy stacks). You understand the unique delivery challenges of robotics compared to traditional software.
Perception & Sensing: Experience with LiDAR, stereoscopic/IR cameras, object detection, spatial mapping, and SLAM in dynamic outdoor environments. Strong understanding of middleware, pub/sub architectures alongside web services, backend technologies, and ML pipelines.
Spatial / CAD Expertise: Deep understanding of software platforms working with geospatial data (GIS, CAD engines, 3D modeling, or automated parametric design).
Industrial Operations: Exposure to automated manufacturing execution systems (MES) managing statistical process control, telemetry monitoring, or fleet analytics in hardtech, renewable energy environments, or advanced manufacturing.

Philosophy On Qualifications And Compensation

Many people only apply for jobs if they believe they can perform every task in the job description. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and will consider equivalent combinations of knowledge, skills, education, and experience. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role.

Additionally, we believe compensation should reflect the value people bring and give them a real stake in what we're building. Our total compensation package includes a base salary, meaningful equity through stock options, and benefits including company holidays, paid time off (PTO), and in-office lunches. Individual pay may vary within the posted range and is determined by a number of factors including relevant experience, skills, and location.

How We Work

We are using sunlight, software, and robots to power the world. It is historic work, and it is hard work. If you want a paved, predictable path, this isn't for you. If you'd rather invent the path, this is the best job you'll ever have.

Call it out. We put big robots in the field alongside our crews and partners. Anyone can stop any operation at any time. The same trust runs everywhere: a bug in the code, a flaw in the plan, a risk in the dirt, a design that no longer makes sense. Say it while it's small and cheap to fix, directly to the person who can fix it. Sometimes that person is you.
Commit and complete. We work problems, not tasks. A confident guess is not a commitment; “I'll find out by Thursday” is. If a date slips, say it early and bring the new plan. Every decision has one owner: bring data, argue hard, push back in the room, then the owner calls it and we lock arms. Execution compounds.
Convention isn't evidence. “Industry standard” is a red flag. Most conventions were answers to constraints that no longer exist. We respect physics and obey the law. Everything else is a choice, and we get to make it.
Let machines do the work. We are system builders: AI and robots do repetitive work in the field and in the office. Every task a machine takes over is a person out of harm's way or off the critical path. Solve a problem once, then build the tool, write the spec, and commit the doc so nobody has to solve it again. Doing it by hand once is fine. Twice means we need a tool.

However you identify, or whatever background you bring with you, please apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

new_jobs.description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry: which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision. We help them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally. We are already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure. It's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company built to endure.
If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the team

Field Engineering at hx is the team that turns ambition into production reality. We sit at the intersection of deep technical delivery, customer transformation, and agentic AI, operating across the most complex pricing and underwriting challenges in the world. In the Americas, we are scaling fast, and this role is the tip of the spear: the person who will define what elite agentic field delivery looks like in the US market and build the team that executes it.

This is not a management layer removed from the work. The team operates with craft at its core, building harnesses, agents, and workflows that don't just close deals but become the foundation for product capabilities used by every customer that follows. We collaborate tightly with AI R&D, Product, and Sales, and we hold ourselves accountable to metrics that matter: GWP throughput, ARR per head, time to live, and bootcamp conversion.

The US Head of Agentic Field Engineering
will own the full arc of the Americas technical delivery motion, from the first conversation with a underwriting leaders to live premium on the platform. This is a rare opportunity to build a function from an early stage, set the bar for what great looks like, and compound your impact across customers, product, and the people you develop.

Check out our Field Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

Lead the full Americas technical delivery motion end to end, personally driving bootcamps on major pursuits alongside Agent Builders, with a target of zero deals lost on technical or delivery-confidence grounds from Q3 onwards.
Quadruple GWP flowing through the platform year on year by expanding existing accounts and landing new logos, while reducing the average time to bring a new line of business live by 50% within 12 months.
Build and operate an agentic OS that systematically upskills a team of agents alongside your Agent Builders, compounding delivery productivity and reducing time to productivity for new joiners
Land a minimum of 3 field-built capabilities into the core product by month 6 through a structured field-to-product feedback cadence operating with the Product leadership team from within 90 days of joining.
Double ARR per head year on year, measured on average ramped FTE inclusive of contractor, partner, and offshore effort
Grow the Americas team and maintain an attrition rate below 20%
Putting a development plan in place for every player-coach

Built agentic AI systems personally and recently, with the ability to walk through the harness architecture, toolchain, and quality validation approach you used, not just an opinion on AI but hands-on delivery.
Grown through engineering into leadership while keeping your hands in the work, whether through active side projects or a demonstrable return to building enabled by agentic AI.
Created internal tooling, harnesses, or workflows that made a team measurably faster, not just optimized delivery for clients but genuinely improved how the people doing the delivering operate.
Tackled the hard 80% of a problem when the easy 20% would have shipped sooner and demoed better, and can speak concretely to what that choice cost and why it was the right call.
Operated in enterprise go-to-market environments with long cycles, multiple buying centers, and implementations measured in quarters, holding a technical room and moving a commercial outcome in the same conversation.
Managed a leadership team of player-coaches, with a genuine track record of making those people better rather than simply directing them, and demonstrated speed of technical assimilation in a new domain under real customer pressure.

Summary

Our client, a small, growing medical device organization, has engaged GForce Life Sciences to provide a Director of Engineering. This role combines people leadership, technical authority, client engagement, and operational ownership. The ideal candidate has deep experience developing drug-device combination products and can lead teams working across autoinjectors, pen injectors, prefilled syringes, on-body/wearable injectors, infusion systems, and related delivery platforms.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set technical direction, develop engineers, strengthen laboratory execution, and serve as a credible technical partner to clients from early development through verification, validation, investigation, and design-history-file execution.

Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of approximately 12–15 engineers; build technical depth through coaching, feedback, mentoring, and clear performance expectations.
Provide technical leadership and final engineering review for protocols, reports, investigations, deviations, test methods, design inputs, risk documentation, and other critical technical deliverables.

Drive engineering excellence across the laboratory by improving technical capability, equipment readiness, documentation quality, throughput, right-first-time execution, and use of sound engineering and statistical methods.
Partner with Quality and Operations to ensure equipment qualification, calibration, maintenance, laboratory readiness, and compliant execution are effectively planned and sustained.

new_jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
The University at Buffalo
(UB) invites nominations and applications for the position of Assistant Vice President of Infrastructure (AVP). Reporting to the Vice President and Chief Information Officer, the AVP will be responsible for leading the Enterprise Infrastructure Services and Network and Communication Services units across UB's three campuses.

University at Buffalo

Impactful research
,scholarly distinction, transformative student experiences, and far-reaching service to local, state, national, and international communities define UB's mission as one of the nation's leading public research universities. UB was founded in 1846 as a private medical college located in downtown Buffalo and joined the SUNY network in 1962. SUNY is the largest state university system in the United States, and UB is a flagship campus and the largest and most comprehensive public research university within the system. In 1989, UB was among the first public universities in the Northeast to be admitted into the AAU. Over the years, UB's scope and mission have expanded significantly as it has grown into a world-renowned research university that is the thriving heart of the regional community, a national leader in public higher education, and a global hub for excellence in research and education.

UB enrolls more than 32,000 students (approximately two-thirds undergraduate and one-third graduate and professional students) and offers more than 500 degree programs at the baccalaureate, master's, professional, and doctoral levels acrossits 12 decanal units
. UB has a distinguished faculty of over 1,500 full-time members. UB is currently undertaking its largest faculty­ hiring initiative in recent history, Advancing Top 25: UB Faculty Hiring
, with plans to recruit upward of 200 full-time faculty over the next two years.

UB is home to more than 120 research centers and institutes; its current annual research expenditures, including those in affiliated institutions, exceed $425 million. UB's academic programs and facilities are located on three distinct campuses in the Buffalo metropolitan area. UB's North Campus, located in the suburb of Amherst, is the university's main undergraduate campus and home to the university's primary athletics and cultural facilities. Three miles to the south, on the northern edge of the City of Buffalo, is the university's historic South Campus, home to many of the university's professional schools. The focal point of UB's third, downtown campus center is the Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus, on which UB's state-of-the-art Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences is in proximity to the university's health and life science partners. UB also competes in the prestigious Mid-American Conference and at the highest level of National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) competition, the FBS Division I level.

With an annual operating revenue of $850 million, UB and its affiliated entities generate an estimated economic impact of $2.1 billion annually in New York State. The university's total workforce of over 9,000 full-time equivalent employees makes it one of the region's largest employers. UB is also a leader and an active partner with the more than 20 public and private colleges and universities in the Buffalo-Niagara region.

The Position

The Assistant Vice President for Infrastructure (AVP)
is a dynamic and visionary leader that is a strategic partner and advisor to the Vice President and Chief Information Officer (VPCIO)
. This is a VPCIO Cabinet Leadership
position that plays a pivotal role in shaping and growing the UB Information Technology (UBIT)
organization to align with and advance the university's goals. As a member of the VPCIO Cabinet, the AVP will ensure that UBIT’s people, processes, and technology are equipped to support the university's mission. The AVP directs special projects and strategic priorities as assigned by the VPCIO, spanning institutional planning, cross-divisional partnerships, and IT governance. This position serves as a senior thought leader in the university’s digital transformation efforts, proactively contributing towards the future direction of technology at the university.

The AVP for Infrastructure
provides strategic leadership for the Enterprise Infrastructure Services (EIS
) and Network and Communication Services (NCS)
units, ensuring UB’s network, cloud, data center, and core computer environments remain secure, reliable, and scalable, while advancing technologies, systems, and processes to meet UB’s goals. Working closely with campus partners and IT leadership, the AVP drives coordinated service delivery, continuous improvement, and infrastructure innovation that supports the university’s academic, research, and administrative needs.

This is a newly created role, and the AVP
will have the opportunity to shape how these two units – each with its own history, culture, and operating rhythm – come together as a single, unified infrastructure organization. The successful candidate will build trust across both teams while also thinking beyond day-to-day operations: reassessing UB’s data center footprint, advancing a deliberate cloud and colocation strategy, and positioning the university’s infrastructure to support an ambitious research and AI agenda. The AVP
will need to balance the discipline required to keep mission-critical systems running with the vision to challenge long-standing practices and move UBIT’s infrastructure into closer alignment with where the university is headed.

Key Responsibilities

Departmental Leadership

Provide strategic direction and oversight to the EIS and NCS units, which includes establishing and advancing a cohesive portfolio strategy aligned with the university’s mission and goals and VPCIO priorities, ensuring coordination across infrastructure and communication systems, emerging technologies, and customer-facing services
This role carries a substantive policymaking function. By directing the planning, design, and operation of the university’s data networks, telecommunications, and enterprise infrastructure systems, the AVP leads the establishment and enforcement of the technical and operational policies that guide campus wide technology use, reliability, security, and compliance. The position’s regular engagement with senior academic and administrative leadership ensures that infrastructure standards and related policies align with institutional priorities.
Lead long-range and annual planning, including workforce and succession planning, budget oversight, and investment prioritization to ensure sustainable operations and future-ready capabilities
Assess the current structure, staffing levels, and operations of EIS and NCS, and lead the organizational changes needed to address staffing gaps, evolving service demands, and succession needs, given the significant portion of both units’ workforce eligible for retirement in the coming years
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement by promoting professional development, mentoring leaders, and enabling teams to deliver high-quality, secure, and customer-centered IT solutions

Drive Strategic Alignment

Ensure that IT initiatives are closely aligned with the university’s strategic goals and mission
Work with university leadership to shape, prioritize, and execute projects that support academic, administrative, and research objectives, while balancing divisional advocacy with institutional priorities and shared enterprise outcomes

Foster Synergies

Promote collaboration and synergy among UBIT departments including but not limited to Innovation, Enterprise Application Services, IT Customer Experience, and Research IT
Leverage strengths and expertise to create a cohesive, efficient IT environment that enhances performance and innovation

Innovate and Transform

Champion innovation and transformation and identify opportunities for technological advancements, process improvements, and new initiatives that move the university forward
Lead the evaluation and evolution of UB’s data center strategy, including assessment of colocation options and consolidation of aging, decentralized data center and server infrastructure across campus
Advance UB’s cloud adoption strategy, building on early planning efforts to shift appropriate administrative and enterprise systems to cloud and hybrid-cloud environments
Partner with UBIT’s Innovation and Research IT units, and academic and research partners to ensure infrastructure supports the university’s growing AI and research computing needs
Champion improvements in customer service and responsiveness across EIS and NCS, working to change perceptions of infrastructure as a barrier to progress and building stronger partnerships with academic and administrative units

Build and Strengthen UBIT

In partnership with other AVPs and senior leaders within UBIT, build and strengthen the VPCIO organization in operating as an integrated leadership team
Develop and implement strategies to enhance the capabilities and effectiveness of UBIT while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and ensuring that the VPCIO is well-positioned to support the university's evolving needs

Buffalo Niagara

As a world-renowned research university, UB's intellectual capital and innovation are playing a vital role in Buffalo's resurgence as a thriving city that is a magnet for talented professionals, artists, entrepreneurs, and innovators who recognize the tremendous energy and momentum gathering here. Home to one of the nation's fastest growing populations of college graduates, the Buffalo­Niagara region, with 1.2 million residents, is the state's second largest major metropolitan area, exceeded only by New York City. The region includes a diverse blend of communities, each with its own distinct personality, yet commonly characterized by a distinctly neighborly way of life, an unpretentious nature and spirited loyalty among residents. Buffalo's own strong sense of community, easy lifestyle, and affordability regularly place it in top ten lists from a variety of national publications for its overall quality of life.

Rich in natural resources and beauty, the Buffalo-Niagara area is a four-season region that offers the best for seasonal sports enthusiasts. University at Buffalo fans enjoy a full complement of NCAA division I sports with the UB Bulls, as well as the NFL's Buffalo Bills, the NH L's Buffalo Sabres, Triple­A baseball's Buffalo Bisons, and the National Lacrosse League's Buffalo Bandits.

Less than a two-hour drive from Buffalo across the United States-Canada border is Toronto, the cultural, entertainment, and financial capital of Canada. Buffalo is also ideally located for easy access to many of America's major cities. The Buffalo-Niagara International Airport offers direct flights to more than 20 cities, including New York, Boston, Philadelphia, Chicago, and Washington, DC, all only an hour's flight away.

UB has played a central role in the creation of a strong, sustainable knowledge economy and thriving entrepreneurial culture that are driving Buffalo's revitalization. Exemplified and driven by the centrally located Buffalo Niagara Medical Campus, UB's Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences, Buffalo is experiencing a period of tremendous progress and momentum as well as unprecedented regional investments in the industries of the future and in the assets that ensure a satisfying quality of life for all its citizens.

Land Acknowledgment

UB acknowledges that our campuses operate on land that is the traditional territory of the Seneca Nation, a member of the Haudenosaunee Confederacy, and the region remains the home of the Haudenosaunee people. Further, we responsibly acknowledge the continuing impact of settler colonialism on the Haudenosaunee and their territories.

new_jobs.title: Director, Product Software Architecture and Eng
new_jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where tech thinkers and future builders turn bold ideas into breakthrough experiences, we welcome your unique perspective.

Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Director, Product Software Architecture and Engineering to build and lead a new dev-ops team offering an AI and container management service for Equinix Managed Solutions. Duties include: Partner with product management to define requirements, service level objectives, and operational goals for the service; Integrate the service with global ordering and back-office systems to provide self-service; Work closely with EMS operations, EMS fulfillment, and Equinix network architecture to ensure the service design is compatible and well-integrated with existing infrastructure; Operate the service at an enterprise availability level as it scales out.

Responsibilities

Service Strategy & Platform Leadership

Define and execute the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for Equinix's AI and Container Management Service.
Partner with Product Management to translate customer needs and market opportunities into platform capabilities.
Establish Service Level Objectives (SLOs), operational standards, and platform governance.
Drive adoption of cloud-native best practices across engineering and operations teams.

Architecture & Engineering

Lead architecture and design decisions and DevOps processes for Kubernetes/OpenShift-based managed services.
Ensure platform scalability, resiliency, security, and operational readiness.
Drive automation across provisioning, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Partner with network, infrastructure, and security teams to ensure seamless integration with Equinix's global platform.

System Optimization

Drives and manages change across the organization by implementing improvements to internal processes and systems
Proactively identifies gaps, risks and issues and influence key stakeholders across the organization to resolve them

Stakeholder Management

Responsible for providing objective and comprehensive input to senior leadership and executive decision makers
Solicits stakeholder input to define comprehensive improvement plans that are consistent and drive standardization across regions
Influences and collaborates with multiple stakeholders of multiple portfolios and projects to ensure effective release, change management and support plans are defined and communicated
Creates and drives broad stakeholder communications with respect to portfolio status and budget utilization

System Optimization

Develop operational KPIs and continuously improve service availability, performance, and customer experience.
Is accountable for successful implementation of approved system improvement recommendations
Drives adoption of best practices and standards

People Management

Build and lead a high-performing global engineering and DevOps organization.
Responsible for succession planning recommendations and contributing to and driving the people development strategy
Responsible for talent development, including quarterly conversations, career pathways conversations and individual development/growth plans
Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Director-level experience managing managers, delivering multiple software products or services
Proven experience leading DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering teams.
Strong and demonstrable operational experience providing a highly available global service
Experience delivering Kubernetes or (preferred) OpenShift-based infrastructure and operating it at scale
15+ years professional experience in a software development leadership role
Bachelor's in Engineering preferred

The targeted pay range for this position in the following location is / locations are:

United States - Redwood City Office GHQ : 240,000 - 360,000 USD / Annual

United States - Denver Office DEO : 200,000 - 300,000 USD / Annual

United States - Dallas Infomart Office DAI : 200,000 - 300,000 USD / Annual

United States - Tampa Office TAO : 200,000 - 300,000 USD / Annual

United States - New York City Office NYO1 : 220,000 - 330,000 USD / Annual

Canada - Toronto Office TRO : 166,000 - 248,000 CAD / Annual

Our pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum target for new hire pay for the full-time position determined by role, level, and location. The pay range shown is based on our compensation structure in place at the time of posting and may be updated periodically based on business needs.
Individual pay is based on additional factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and/or training.

The targeted pay range listed reflects the base pay only and does not include bonus, equity, or benefits. Employees are eligible for bonus, and equity may be offered depending on the position.

Equinix Benefits

As an employee, you become important to Equinix’s success. We ensure all your benefits are in line with our core values: competitive, inclusive, sustainable, connected and efficient. We keep them competitive within the current marketplace to ensure we’re providing you with the best package possible. So, wherever you are in your career and life, you’ll be able to enhance your experience and bring your whole self to work.

Employee Assistance Program
: An Employee Assistance program is available to all employees.

US Benefits: - Insurance: You may enroll in health, life, disability and voluntary plans that are designed for you and your eligible family members. - Retirement: You and Equinix may contribute to a retirement plan to help you plan for your financial future. - Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays: You will receive an accrued amount of PTO each pay period along with various paid holidays for you to rest and recharge. Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific plan or program terms. Canada Core Benefits: - Insurance: You may enroll in healthcare coverage that is designed to complement the provincial healthcare system, along with life, disability and optional benefit plans that are designed for you and your eligible family members. - Retirement: You may also enroll in Equinix-sponsored retirement or savings plans: Defined Contribution Pension Plan (DCPP), Group Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) and Tax-Free Savings Plan (TSFA). - Vacation and Paid Holidays: Equinix offers both vacation and personal time, along with various paid holidays for you to rest and recharge. Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits. Benefits are subject to specific plan or program terms, and to change at Equinix discretion.
